title.it: Gli animali del regno di Alabasta
title.es: ¡El sprint milagroso! Arabasta, el país animal

title.ar: اندفاع من أجل معجزة! أرض حيوانات ألاباستا!
title.th: มุ่งหน้าไปสู่ปาฏิหารย์..ดินแดนแห่งสัตว์ป่าอลาบัสต้า
title.x-jat: Kiseki e no Shissou! Arabasta Doubutsu Land

111.overview: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysterious Miss All-Sunday. The rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna.
111.summary:
Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 反乱軍VS国王軍! 決戦はアルバーナ!
title.en: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna
title.fr: Les rebelles contre l’armée du roi ! La confrontation finale aura lieu à Alubarna !
title.it: La battaglia decisiva: rivoltosi contro esercito reale
title.es: ¡Ejército rebelde contra ejército Real! ¡La batalla será en Alubarna!
title.ru: Королевское войско против войска поувстанцев! Поле решающей битвы — Алубарна!
title.ar: جيش المتمردين ضد الجيش الملكي! مواجهة في ألوبارنا!
title.th: คณะปฏิวัติ ปะทะ ทหารรักษาอาณาจักร..ศึกตัดสินที่อัลบาน่า
title.x-jat: Hanrangun Tai Kokuougun! Kessen wa Alubarna!

112.overview: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.
112.summary:
Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 嘆きのアルバーナ! 激闘カルー隊長!
title.en: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo
title.fr: La douleur d’Alubarna ! Le chef d’escadron Kaloo se lance au combat !
title.es: ¡Alubarna llora! ¡La feroz batalla del capitán Carue!
title.ru: Стон над Алубарной! Битва капитана Кару!
title.ar: حسرة ألوبارنا! القائد الشّرس كارو!
title.th: อัลบาน่าตกอยู่ในวิกฤต..ศึกนองเลือดของหัวหน้ากาลู
title.x-jat: Nageki no Alubarna! Gekitou Carue Taichou!

113.overview: Vivi's attempts to stop the rebel army go to waste, and she is attacked by Mr. 2 Bon Clay, but manages to escape. Meanwhile, the battle of Usopp and Chopper vs. the Mr. 4 team begins.
113.summary:
Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna`s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 仲間の夢に誓う! 決闘モグラ塚4番街
title.en: Sworn on a Friend`s Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4
title.fr: Le rêve d’un ami ! Duel sur la Quatrième Avenue de la taupinière !
title.es: ¡Fe en el sueño de tu amigo! Batalla en la cuarta base de la topera
title.ru: Клятва, посвящённая мечте соратников! Сражение на кротовьем холме, 4-й квартал
title.ar: عهدٌ على حلم صديق! معركة تلّ الخلد، المجمّع 4
title.th: สาบานต่อความฝันของเพื่อน..ศึกตัดสินที่เนินตัวตุ่นเมืองเบอร์สี่
title.x-jat: Nakama no Yume ni Chikau! Kettou Mogurazuka 4-bangai

114.overview: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.
114.summary:
Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy`s weakness.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 本日大公開! マネマネモンタージュ!
title.en: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage
title.fr: La performance du jour ! L`assemblage facial !
title.es: ¡La gran función de hoy! Mane Mane Montage
title.ru: Грандиозное представление! Доппель-доппель монтаж!
title.ar: اليوم هو يوم الافتتاح الكبير! مونتاج النّسخ!
title.th: สุดยอดการแสดงวันนี้ มอนตาคิวเลียนแบบ
title.x-jat: Honjitsu Daikoukai! Mane-Mane Montage!

115.overview: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.
115.summary:
Chopper`s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 友[ナミ]に変身! ボンクレー連発バレエ拳法
title.en: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay`s Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
title.fr: Il s`est transformé en Nami ?! Bon Clay et son coup de ballet !
title.es: ¡Transformándose en Nami! El devastador Ballet Kenpo de Bon Kure
title.ru: Превращение в Нами! Град ударов балетного кэмпо Бон Клея
title.ar: التحوّل إلى نامي! كينبو باليه بون كوري السّريع المتتابع
title.th: แปลงร่างเป็นเพื่อน เพลงหมัดกระเทยของโบนเคร
title.x-jat: Nami ni Henshin! Bon Clay Renpatsu Ballet Kenpou

116.overview: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.
116.summary:
Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; and Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ナミの旋風注意報! クリマタクト炸裂
title.en: Nami`s Cyclone Advisory! Clima Tact Burst!
title.fr: Avis de tempête ! Le bâton climatique de Nami !
title.it: Il bastone Klimattack, l`arma speciale di Nami
title.es: ¡El barómetro de presiones de Nami! El Clima Tact explota
title.ru: Нами предупреждает об урагане! Взрыв погодного посоха
title.ar: إعصار نامي المنذر! انفجار عصا الطّقس!
title.th: ระวังลมหมุนของนามิให้ดี..ระเบิดกระบองคุริมะ
title.x-jat: Nami no Senpuu Chuuihou! Clima Takt Sakuretsu

117.overview: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon, the Klima Takt (Climate Baton), at the same time.
117.summary:
Things don`t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami`s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 王家に伝わる秘密! 古代兵器プルトン
title.en: Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
title.fr: Le secret de la famille royale ! Une arme antique : Pluton !
title.es: ¡El secreto de la Familia Real! El arma ancestral, Plutón
title.ru: Секрет королевской династии! Древнее оружие Плутон
title.ar: سرّ مُتوارث في العائلة المالكة! السّلاح العتيق بلوتون
title.th: ความลับที่สืบทอดกันมาในหมู่ราชา..อาวุธโบราณพูลตั้น
title.x-jat: Ouke ni Tsutawaru Himitsu! Kodai Heiki Pluton

118.overview: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.
118.summary:
Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact`s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 豪剣の極意! 鋼鉄を斬る力と物の呼吸
title.en: Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!
title.fr: Le secret d`un bon sabre ! Le pouvoir de fendre l`acier !
title.es: ¡La esencia de una espada poderosa! El poder de cortar el acero y el aliento de todas las cosas
title.ru: Секрет величия меча! Сила, рассекающая сталь, и дыхание всего сущего
title.ar: سرّ المسايفة القويّة! القدرة على قطع الفولاذ ونفَس كلّ شيء
title.th: ความลับของความจริง..ลมหายใจของสรรพสิ่งและพลังที่ตัดเหล็ก
title.x-jat: Gouken no Gokui! Koutetsu o Kiru Chikara to Mono no Kokyuu

119.overview: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro can't cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".
119.summary:
Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel - or die trying.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 戦いは終わった!コーザが掲げた白い旗
title.en: The Battle Is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
title.fr: Fin du combat ! Le drapeau blanc de Koza !
title.es: ¡La batalla ha terminado! Kohza ondea la bandera blanca
title.ru: Битва окончена! Кодза поднимает белый флаг
title.ar: انتهت المعركة! يرفع كوزا راية الاستسلام
title.th: การต่อสู้สิ้นสุดลง โคซ่ายอมยกธงขาว
title.x-jat: Tatakai wa Owatta! Kooza ga Kakageta Shiroi Hata

120.overview: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Kohza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.
120.summary:
Koza - the leader of the rebel army - finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta`s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ビビの声の行方! 英雄[ヒーロー]は舞い降りた!
title.en: Where Vivi`s Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
title.fr: Vivi sans voix ! Le héros tombé du ciel !
title.es: ¡La voz de Vivi no se oye! ¡Llega un héroe!
title.ru: Голос Виви! Герой спускается с небес!
title.ar: حيث يُسمع صوت فيفي! هبوط البطل!
title.th: หนทางแห่งเสียงของวีวี่ วีรสตรีร่ายรำลงมาแล้ว
title.x-jat: Vivi no Koe no Yukue! Hero wa Maiorita!

121.overview: As Kohza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.
121.summary:
When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi`s cries for a cease fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 砂ワニと水ルフィ! 決闘第2ラウンド
title.en: Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel!
title.fr: Le sable du croco contre l’eau de Luffy ! Le second round du duel !
title.es: ¡Cocodrilo de arena y Luffy de agua! Segunda ronda del combate a muerte
title.ru: Песчаный крокодил и водяной Луффи! Второй раунд поединка
title.ar: تمساح الرّمل ضدّ لوفي الماء! الجولة الثّانية من النّزال!
title.th: ศึกตัดสินครั้งที่ 2 จระเข้ทรายปะทะลูฟี่ร่างน้ำ
title.x-jat: Suna Wani to Mizu Luffy! Kettou Dai 2 Round

122.overview: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.
122.summary:
Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won`t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ワニっぽい! 王家の墓へ走れルフィ!
title.en: That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
title.fr: Ça sent le Croco ! Luffy, cours jusqu`au mausolée royal !
title.es: ¡Huele a cocodrilo! ¡Corre hasta la tumba de la Familia Real, Luffy!
title.ru: Запахло крокодилом! Луффи, беги к королевской гробнице!
title.ar: يبدو ذلك تمساحيًّا! لوفي، اركض إلى الضّريح الملكيّ!
title.th: ไอ้จระเข้โฉด ลูฟี่มุ่งหน้าไปสู่สุสานของราชวงศ์สิ
title.x-jat: Wanippoi! Ouke no Haka e Hashire Luffy!

123.overview: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.
123.summary:
While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country`s greatest secret.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 悪夢の時迫る! ここは砂砂団秘密基地
title.en: The Nightmare Draws Near! This Is the Sand-Sand Clan`s Secret Base
title.fr: A deux doigts du cauchemar ! La base secrète du Clan des sables
title.es: ¡La pesadilla de acerca! La base secreta del clan Suna Suna
title.ru: Надвигается катастрофа! Секретная база Песчаной банды
title.ar: يقترب الكابوس! هذه القاعدة السريّة لجماعة الرّمل
title.th: บุกสู่ช่วงเวลาแห่งฝันร้าย ที่นี่คือฐานทัพลับของกลุ่มเม็ดทราย
title.x-jat: Akumu no Toki Semaru! Koko wa Sunasunadan Himitsu Kichi

124.overview: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.
124.summary:
With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 偉大なる翼! 我が名は国の守護神ペル
title.en: Magnificent Wings! My Name Is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country
title.fr: Les ailes déployées ! Je suis Pell, l`ange gardien du royaume !
title.es: ¡Magníficas alas! Mi nombre es Pell, espíritu guardián de Arabasta
title.ru: Исполинские крылья! Имя мне Пелл, дух-хранитель Алабасты
title.ar: الجناحان المذهلان! اسمي بيل الإله الوصي للدولة
title.th: ปีกแห่งเกียรติยศ นามของข้าคือทหารรักษาอาณาจักรเปร
title.x-jat: Idainaru Tsubasa! Waga Na wa Kuni no Shugoshin Pell

125.overview: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Alabasta.
125.summary:
The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 越えていく! アラバスタに雨が降る!
title.en: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Arabasta!
title.fr: Je te battrai ! Il pleut sur Alabasta !
title.it: La pioggia è tornata sul regno di Alabasta
title.es: ¡Te superaré! ¡La lluvia cae sobre Arabasta!
title.ru: Я превзойду тебя! В Алабасте идёт дождь!
title.ar: سأتخطاك! هطول المطر على ألاباستا
title.th: ชั้นจะก้าวข้ามแก ฝนตกในอลาบาสต้า
title.x-jat: Koeteiku! Arabasta ni Ame ga Furu!

126.summary:
Pell`s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile`s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta`s oppressor.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 武器よさらば! 海賊といくつかの正義
title.en: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
title.fr: L`adieu aux armes ! Justice et Piraterie !
title.es: ¡Adiós a la armas! Piratas y un poco de justicia
title.ru: Прощай, оружие! Пираты и несбывшаяся справедливость
title.ar: توديع الأسلحة! القراصنة والأفكار المختلقة عن العدالة
title.th: ทิ้งอาวุธ! โจรสลัดและความยุติธรรมเล็กๆ
title.x-jat: Buki yo Saraba! Kaizoku to Ikutsuka no Seigi

127.overview: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Kohza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.
127.summary:
Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi`s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 海賊たちの宴とアラバスタ脱出作戦!
title.en: The Pirates` Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!
title.fr: Les pirates font la fête ! Un plan pour fuir Alabasta !
title.es: El banquete de los piratas y la operación huida de Arabasta
title.ru: Пиратский пир и план побега из Алабасты!
title.ar: مأدبة القراصنة وعمليّة الهروب من ألاباستا
title.th: การเลี้ยงฉลองของพวกโจรสลัด และแผนการหลบหนีออกจากอลาบาสต้า
title.x-jat: Kaizoku-tachi no Utage to Arabasta Dasshutsu Sakusen!

128.overview: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.
128.summary:
Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 始まりはあの日! ビビが語る冒険譚!
title.en: It All Started on That Day...! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!
title.fr: Le jour où tout a commencé ! Vivi raconte son aventure !
title.es: ¡Todo comenzó ese día! Vivi cuenta sus aventuras
title.ru: Всё началось в тот день! Виви рассказывает о своих приключениях!
title.ar: كانت البداية في ذلك اليوم! تقصّ فيفي حكاية مغامرتها!
title.th: มันเริ่มจากตอนนั้นเรื่องราวการผจญภัยของวีวี่
title.x-jat: Hajimari wa Ano Hi! Vivi ga Kataru Boukentan!

129.overview: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Clay and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.
129.summary:
Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 危険な香り! 七人目はニコ・ロビン!
title.en: Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member Is Nico Robin!
title.fr: Un parfum de danger ! Nico Robin, le septième compagnon
title.es: ¡Cuidado con su fragancia! El séptimo de a bordo es Nico Robin
title.ru: Опасный аромат! Седьмая — Нико Робин!
title.ar: رائحة الخطر! العضوة السّابعة نيكو روبين!
title.th: สัญญาณอันตราย สมาชิกคนที่ 7 คือนิโคโรบิน
title.x-jat: Kiken na Kaori! Shichininme wa Nico Robin!

130.overview: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from the Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of the Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.
130.summary:
Luffy and his crew watch Alabasta fade into the distance, but there`s no time for reminiscing. The marines are in hot pursuit, and there`s a stowaway aboard the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: はじめての患者[クランケ]! ランブルボール秘話
title.en: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!
title.fr: La toute première patiente ! Révélations sur la Rumble Ball
title.es: ¡El primer paciente! La anécdota de la Rumble Ball
title.ru: Первый пациент! История Рамбл Бола
title.ar: المريض الأوّل! قصّة كرة رامبل الّتي لم تُروَ
title.th: คนไข้รายแรกและเรื่องราวของรัมเบิ้ลบอล
title.x-jat: Hajimete no Kranke! Rumble Ball Hiwa

131.overview: The Straw Hats land on an uninhabited island; Sanji immediately notices that it is covered with fruit-bearing trees. The crew decides to divide the work by drawing straws. Luffy, Zoro, and Usopp are sent to gather the fruit while Nami and Sanji survey the island. Chopper is left to guard the ship. He enjoys himself but suddenly realizes that Robin is nearby and flees into the cabin. He works on producing Rumble Balls and talks to himself about his mentor, Dr. Kureha, but notices that Robin is listening to him and breaks a barrel of water in surprise. Robin accompanies Chopper as he goes to replace the spilled liquid and he tells Robin about Dr. Kureha and how she became his first patient.
131.summary:
Fresh off their adventure Alabasta, the Straw Hats discover an isolated island where they can restock their food supply. Chopper is left to guard the ship, but he and Nico spend the afternoon exploring instead!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 航海士の反乱! ゆずれない夢の為に!
title.en: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!
title.fr: Rébellion d`un navigateur ! Le rêve de Nami !
title.es: ¡El motín de la navegante! ¡Por un sueño firme!
title.ru: Мятеж штурмана! Непоколебимая мечта!
title.ar: تمرّد الملاّحة! من أجل حُلم لا يتزعزع!
title.th: การสไตรค์ของต้นหน เพื่อความฝันไม่มีวันปล่อยให้หลุดมือ
title.x-jat: Koukaishi no Hanran! Yuzurenai Yume no Tame ni!

132.overview: While fishing with Chopper and Usopp, Luffy fishes an ammonite-shaped vehicle out of the sea. The pirates debate if it is edible, but to their surprise, its side opens and a traveling salesman emerges. He offers them obscure items and tries to sell a pile of paper to Nami. However, before he can settle the deal, the salesman realizes that he is on a pirate ship and flees in panic, abandoning his merchandise. With the paper, Nami can finally begin drawing the map of the world that she has dreamed about making since her childhood. However, because the rest of the crew is causing mischief, she has trouble completing her work and has to restart twice before finishing her map of Reverse Mountain.
132.summary:
When a mail-order salesman gets lost at sea, Nami finds the paper she needs to start making maps. If the Straw Hat crew can somehow manage to survive a deadly cyclone, she might actually get some use out of it!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 受け継がれる夢[レシピ]! カレーの鉄人サンジ
title.en: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry
title.fr: Comment on transmet une recette ! Sanji, le pro du Curry !
title.es: ¡La receta heredada! Sanji, el experto en curry
title.ru: Унаследованный рецепт! Санджи, эксперт по карри
title.ar: وصفة متوارثة! سانجي، رجل الكاري الحديديّ
title.th: ฝันที่ได้รับช่วงต่อ แกงกระหรี่ของซันจิจอมอึด
title.x-jat: Uketsugareru Recipe! Curry no Tetsujin Sanji

133.overview: In a thick bank of fog, the Straw Hats run into a fleet of navy ships. Surprised by the sight of the skull and crossbones on the pirate ship's sails, the young trainee cook Tajiyo falls off of his navy vessel. Robin catches him before he hits the water and the boy regains consciousness in the Straw Hats' cabin. Scared at first, he loosens up when presented by Sanji with a soup of surprising quality. The small cook reveals his problem: he spilled the day's production of curry and has been charged with replacing it. To compound the issue, the fleet's captains plan to dine aboard his ship. Luffy and Sanji take Tajiyo back to his ship, where Sanji provides him with subtle cooking advice. Tajiyo's new curry turns out perfectly and the Straw Hats escape before the fog lifts in the mid-day sun.
133.summary:
Heavy fog leads to a close encounter of the culinary kind when Nico fishes a marine out of the drink. The aspiring chef is concerned about the quality of his curry, and Sanji is just the guy to refine his recipe!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 咲かせてみせます! 男ウソップ八尺玉
title.en: I Will Make It Bloom! Usopp the Man and the Eight-Foot Shell!
title.fr: Explosion de couleurs ! Usopp et le feu d`artifice géant !
title.es: ¡La haré florecer! La bola 8-Shaku del varonil Usopp
title.ru: Я заставлю его расцвести! Мужественный восьмифутовый фейерверк Усоппа
title.ar: سأجعلها تتفتّح! الرّجل أوسوبّ وكرة الثّمانية شاكو!
title.th: มาทำให้ดอกไม้บานกันเถอะ บอลแปดธาตุของชายชื่ออุซป
title.x-jat: Sakasete Misemasu! Otoko Usopp Hasshakudama

134.overview: Because it is raining, Luffy reads out of boredom. Fortunately for him, the Straw Hats' ship reaches the next island. Walking through its port town, they learn that the island known for its yearly fireworks show, which was to occur that day. The fireworks factory, run by an old man named Odama and his granddaughter Kodama, is on a hill outside the town. Usopp goes there, hoping for an opportunity to buy gunpowder. At the factory, he helps Odama and Kodama prepare for the show. Usopp learns that Kodama plans to secretly fire the second of two eight-shaku-tall firework balls to fulfill her parents' dream. Her parents died the previous year after the first misfired, and Usopp convinces Kodama that it is too dangerous for her to fire it. Usopp uses a tall, ancient building to safely launch the large firework ball.
134.summary:
A break in the rain provides the perfect opportunity for Usopp to help a young girl fulfill her dream of launching the world`s largest firework.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 噂の海賊狩り! さすらいの剣士ゾロ
title.en: The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, The Wandering Swordsman
title.fr: Un célèbre chasseur de pirates. Zoro, le sabreur errant !
title.it: Zoro, il famoso cacciatore di pirati
title.es: ¡El infame cazador de piratas! El espadachín errante, Zoro
title.ru: Печально известный «Охотник на пиратов»! Странствующий фехтовальщик Зоро!
title.ar: صائد القراصنة الخرافيّ! زورو السّيّاف المتجوّل
title.th: ข่าวลือของนักล่าโจรสลัด การเดินทางของนักดาบโซโล
title.x-jat: Uwasa no Kaizokugari! Sasurai no Kenshi Zoro

135.overview: Before he meets Luffy, Zoro traveled the world in search of "Hawk-Eye" Mihawk. In a flashback, Zoro captures the target of the bounty hunters Johnny and Yosaku in a bar. According to bounty hunter rules, they demand that he relinquish the victim's body to them. Zoro, who does not consider himself a bounty hunter, complies, explaining that he only brings in a bounty from time to time so that he can survive until he can become the greatest swordsman in the world. Later that day, a group of bandits, led by a man with a much higher bounty, plunders the village. Johnny and Yosaku, inspired by Zoro's conviction, decide to take on the villain, but are quickly defeated. As the bandits prepare to kill the pair, Zoro returns and saves Johnny and Yosaku. After he defeats the bandits and their leader, Johnny and Yosaku become his followers.
135.summary:
Money troubles force Zoro to tangle with Dick the Bandit and his treacherous gang of thugs. These gun-toting outlaws are terrorizing a peaceful village, and the Straw Hat swordsman aims to stop their reign of terror!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ヤギの島のゼニィと山の中の海賊船!
title.en: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!
title.fr: Zeny de l`Île aux chèvres ! Un bateau pirate dans la montagne !
title.it: L`isola delle capre e la nave misteriosa
title.es: ¡Zenny de la Isla de las Cabras y el barco pirata en las montañas!
title.ru: Зенни, живущий на Козьем острове! Пиратский корабль на вершине горы!
title.ar: زيني من جزيرة الجديان وسفينة القراصنة في الجبال!
title.th: เกาะแห่งแพะของเซนี่ และเรือโจรสลัดในหุบเขา
title.x-jat: Yagi no Shima no Zenny to Yama no Naka no Kaizokusen!

136.overview: A few navy ships chase the Straw Hats. To escape them, the Straw Hats sail through an area of wild currents, which surround an island that is only inhabited by an old man named Zenii and his goats. Zenii realizes that the Straw Hats are pirates and sends his goats to attack them. During the fight Zenii's heart stops from fear. The Straw Hats take him to his home, nurse him back to health, and complete his chores, such as cleaning his house, preparing meals, and chopping wood. Zoro searches for food and discovers a small nearly completed pirate ship atop the island's mountain. At the day's end, as the crew is about to leave, Chopper reveals that the old man will die within three days. Driven by guilt, the Straw Hats decide to stay with him until then.
136.summary:
A barrage of Marine cannon balls forces the Straw Hats to seek refuge on an uncharted island. Once ashore, the crew encounters a strange old man living amongst a herd of goats.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 儲かりまっか? 金貸しゼニィの野望!
title.en: How`s Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!
title.fr: Alors, ça marche les affaires ? Le rêve de Zeny l`usurier !
title.es: ¿Trato hecho? ¡La ambición de Zenny el prestamista!
title.ru: Как вам такая прибыль? Амбиции ростовщика Зенни!
title.ar: ما رأيك بهذه الحيل المربحة؟ طموحات زيني الدّائِن!
title.th: กำไรพอรึยังละ? ความทะเยอทะยานของเซนี่จอมปล่อยกู้
title.x-jat: Moukarimakka? Kanekashi Zenny no Yabou!

137.overview: The Straw Hats continue to do Zenii's daily work and finish building his pirate ship, which he intends to use as a coffin. Zoro eventually realizes that the three days until Zenii's death, which Chopper had diagnosed, have long passed, but by the time he convinces the others to leave, Nami has already lost the Straw Hats' ship in a game of chess. Robin wins it back and they all have a party. As Zenii becomes drunk, he recollects his past as a moneylender who lent money to pirates. He describes how he was shipwrecked twenty years earlier, and that he, in hopes of one day becoming a pirate, started building a ship. As the years passed, he became too old for a pirate's life. Luffy disagrees, saying that pirates can be of any age. The next day, a group of marines lures the Straw Hats into a trap. To save them, Zenii and his goats ride his ship down the mountainside.
137.summary:
Old man Zenny made a fortune lending money to scallywags, but he always dreamed of becoming a pirate himself. When the marines set out to trap the Straw Hats, the wily hermit may finally get his wish!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 島のお宝の行方! ゼニィ海賊団出撃!
title.en: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!
title.fr: Le trésor caché de l`île aux chèvres ! L’équipage de Zeny le pirate à l’abordage !
title.es: ¡El escondite del tesoro! ¡Piratas de Zenny, a la carga!
title.ru: Где же сокровище? Пираты Зенни наступают!
title.ar: مكان كنز الجزيرة! هجوم قراصنة زيني!
title.th: เกาะที่ไม่มีสมบัติ กลุ่มโจรสลัดเซนี่ออกเรือ!!
title.x-jat: Shima no Otakara no Yukue! Zenny Kaizokudan Shutsugeki!

138.overview: The commotion caused by Zenii's arrival allows Nami, Sanji, Usopp, and Chopper to board their ship safely. Zenii and his goats get on the navy ship and Zenii uses of his martial arts skills, with a counting frame to fight. Luffy attempts to slingshot himself over to help him, but lands in the water instead. Zoro immediately jumps in after him to rescue the non-swimmer, only to be run over by the Straw Hats' own ship. The marines are eventually defeated, but a fleet of nine more ships is still waiting in the fog surrounding the island. Zenii tells the Straw Hats that, on his arrival on the island, the goats ate all of his money and that they became his treasure instead. The Straw Hats give Zenii enough medicine to survive and leave the island, escaping from the navy.
138.summary:
Zenny gets more than he bargained for when he embarks on his maiden pirate voyage. The Straw Hats may have made a friend for life, but what are they gonna do about those pesky marines?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 虹色の霧伝説! ルルカ島[とう]の老人ヘンゾ
title.en: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island
title.fr: Une brume mystérieuse aux couleurs arc-en-ciel... Henzo, le vieil homme de l`île de Ruruka
title.es: ¡La leyenda de la Niebla Arcoíris! El viejo Henzo y la Isla Ruruka
title.ru: Легенда радужного тумана! Старик Хензо с острова Рулука!
title.ar: أسطورة ضباب قوس قزح! جزيرة لولوكا والعجوز هينزو
title.th: ตำนานหมอกสีรุ้ง ลุงเฮนโซแห่งเกาะลูลูกะ
title.x-jat: Niji-iro no Kiri Densetsu! Ruluka Tou no Roujin Henzo

139.overview: After escaping from another fleet of navy ships, the Straw Hats drop anchor outside a town with a huge tower. After they set foot on land, an official demands that they pay a harbor tax. The Straw Hats meet a scientist named Henzo, who asks them if they have seen what he calls the "Rainbow Mist." The other citizens of the town dislike Henzo because they have to pay high taxes to fund for his research. While shopping with Nami and Chopper, Sanji has a violent encounter with a tax collector, who is wearing an electric battle suit. A large, unmanned galley appears in the harbor, in the same condition that Henzo saw it fifty years ago. Henzo, Luffy, Robin, and Usopp aboard it. Further out at sea, a rainbow-colored mist appears and the group uses the Straw Hats' ship to enter it.
139.summary:
The Straw Hats stop for supplies at a harbor town plagued by a mayor who taxes anything and everything. Over lunch, Luffy and Nico befriend a kooky scientist who`s obsessed with the Rainbow Mist.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 永遠の国の住人! パンプキン海賊団!
title.en: Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates
title.fr: Habitants d’un pays hors du temps. Les Pirates à la citrouille !
title.it: La banda dei pirati della zucca
title.es: ¡Los habitantes de Nunca Jamás! ¡Los piratas de la Calabaza!
title.ru: Жители Небыляндии! Тыквенные пираты!
title.ar: سكّان أرض البقاء! قراصنة اليقطين!
title.th: คนที่อยู่ในเนเวอร์แลนด์ กลุ่มโจรสลัดฟักทอง
title.x-jat: Eien no Kuni no Juunin! Pumpkin Kaizokudan!

140.overview: Inside the mist, Luffy and his group discover a large ship graveyard. Luffy salvages a chest filled with gold and jewels from one of the shipwrecks, but a distant voice tells him to return the treasure and leave the mist. Usopp believes the voices to be ghosts, but they actually originate from a group of children who call themselves the Pumpkin Pirates. In his youth, Henzo was a member of this group, and they are the reason for his research. He spent his life in search of a means to rescue them from the Rainbow Mist. Only a short time earlier from their point of view, but fifty years earlier from Henzo's perspective, a group of pirates, led by a Captain Whetton, attacked the children's town. When Whetton came after the children, they tried to escape by stealing the pirates' ship. During the fight, Whetton smashed the ship's helm, and Henzo jumped overboard, taking Whetton with him, while the other children sailed into the mist.
140.summary:
Luffy, Usopp, Nico, and Zoro get trapped in the Rainbow Mist along with Henzo. The aging scientist is looking for answers, the Straw Hats want treasure, and the ghosts who haunt the mist want them all to leave!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 故郷への想い! 脱出不能の海賊墓場!
title.en: Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!
title.fr: Le mal du pays ! Un cimetière de pirates dont nul ne revient !
title.it: Il cimitero dei pirati, un luogo senza ritorno
title.es: ¡Añoranza del hogar! ¡El ineludible cementerio de piratas!
title.ru: Скучая по дому! Несбегательное пиратское кладбище!
title.ar: مشاعر الحنين! مقبرة القراصنة الّتي لا خروج منها!
title.th: ค้นหาทางกลับบ้านเกิด หนีออกจากสุสานเรือซึ่งไร้กาลเวลา
title.x-jat: Furusato e no Omoi! Dasshutsu Funou no Kaizoku Hakaba!

141.overview: After entering the Rainbow Mist, the children followed the orders of Ian, the only pirate left on the ship. He mistreated them and they eventually locked him up in the brig of the wreck of a navy ship. Luffy and his group try to escape the mist, but they soon realize that they need help. The Straw Hats persuade one of the children to lead them to the Pumpkin Pirates' hiding place so they can ask them for a way out. Usopp prepares a steaming meal, which causes most of the children to like the Straw Hats; however, their leader, Lapanui, remains suspicious and unwilling to help. Henzo's snail-o-phone rings and the son of Whetton wants Henzo to investigate the mist, not knowing that the professor is already inside the mist. When Lapanui hears Whetton's name, he loses what little he trust has for Henzo.
141.summary:
Luffy and his crew search for a way out of Ape`s Concert, but the Rainbow Mist is an inescapable maze of madness. Back on shore, Nami, Chopper, and Sanji face a lifetime of hard labor for failing to pay their taxes!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 乱戦必死! ウェットンの野望と虹の塔
title.en: An Inevitable Melee! Wetton`s Schemes and the Rainbow Tower
title.fr: Bataille générale ! Le plan de Wetton et la Tour Arc-en-ciel !
title.it: Scontro in vista: Wetton raggiunge la nebbia color arcobaleno
title.es: ¡Confusión y lucha inevitable! La ambición de Whetton y la torre Arcoíris
title.ru: Яростная схватка! Планы Вэттона и Радужная башня!
title.ar: اشتباكٌ محتوم! مخطّطات ويتّون وبرج قوس قزح!
title.th: สู้กันสุดฤทธิ์ ตวามทะเยอะทะยานของวันตั้นและหอคอยสีรุ้ง
title.x-jat: Ransen Hisshi! Wetton no Yabou to Niji no Tou

142.overview: Lapanui accuses Henzo of being Whetton's lapdog and says that in the past, Henzo would have never allowed that to happen. Usopp tells Lapanui that Henzo had endured the same insults from the townspeople yet still tried to rescue the children. Then, for no apparent reason, Luffy slingshots himself and Lapanui to another part of the mist. At the harbor, Nami ties a long lifeline, prepared by Henzo, to a boat and enters the Rainbow Mist. Once inside, Ian, who convinced one of the children to release him, steals the boat and escapes. He reaches Whetton and describes to him the mist's treasures. Whetton orders his men to invade the mist. The town's large tower falls into the water, creating a bridge from the island into the mist, and Whetton and his men cross it to attack.
142.summary:
Nami enters the mist on a mission to save her mates - and maybe hunt for treasure while she`s at it. The local mayor wants her dead, but the Straw Hats are being protected by a mysterious marine.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: そして伝説が始まる! いざ虹の彼方へ
title.en: And So, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow
title.fr: La légende reprend ! L`aventure continue par delà la brume !
title.es: ¡Comienza la leyenda! Más allá de la niebla
title.ru: Так началась легенда! К концу радуги
title.ar: وهكذا تبدأ الأسطورة! الجانب الآخر من قوس قزح!
title.th: และแล้วตำนานก็เริ่มขึ้น มุ่งสู่ทางสายรุ้งกันเถอะ
title.x-jat: Soshite Densetsu ga Hajimaru! Iza Niji no Kanata e

143.overview: Luffy and Lapanui are outside the mist and use the newly created bridge to re-enter it. There, Luffy fights Whetton and, as it becomes clear that he cannot defeat Luffy face-to-face, Whetton detonates the tower, trapping everyone else inside and Whetton's abandoned men join forces with Luffy's group. An exit appears in the distance and they row toward it, but it closes too fast for them to reach it. Hoping to generate enough wind to blow the Straw Hats' ship clear of the mist, Lapanui stays behind to destroy the navy ship's armory. The other children follow him, promising to meet Henzo again. The explosion they cause successfully blows the Straw Hats' ship outside the mist. There, a group of navy ships, led by an aged Lapanui, arrives and confiscates the Rainbow Mist's treasures from Whetton and takes him and his men into custody.
143.summary:
The showdown with Mayor Wetton builds towards an explosive finale as the Straw Hats scramble to escape the Rainbow Mist - or be trapped inside forever.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 奪われた記録[ログ]! サルベージ王マシラ!
title.en: Caught Log! The King of Salvagers, Masira!
title.fr: Le log détraqué ? Masira, le roi du repêchage !
title.it: Masira, il re del recupero delle navi affondate
title.es: ¡Dirección imposible! Masira, el rey del reflotamiento
title.ru: Застрявший лог. Король Salvage, Масира!
title.ar: سُجّلت الوجهة التّالية! ماسيرا، ملك إنقاذ السّفن!
title.th: สัญญาณที่ถูกขโมยไป เจ้าแห่งการกู้ซากเรือมาชิร่า
title.x-jat: Ubawareta Log! Salvage-ou Mashira!

144.overview: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, after that, a big ship falls from sky and the crew finds a map in of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.
144.summary:
The Straw Hats are nearly crushed by the falling wreckage of a ship that`s over 200 years old. Could rumors of a floating island in the sky be true? Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji go scuba diving to find out!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 怪物登場! 白ひげ一味には手を出すな
title.en: Monsters Appear! Don`t Mess with the White Beard Pirates!
title.fr: Apparition de monstres ! N`approchez pas de Barbe Blanche !
title.it: State lontani dalla flotta di Barbabianca
title.es: ¡Aparece un monstruo! No os acerquéis a los piratas de Shirohige
title.ru: Появление чудовищ! Не трожь пиратов Белоуса!
title.ar: ظهور وحوش! لا تعبثوا مع قراصنة اللّحية البيضاء
title.th: ปากทางเข้าสัตว์ประหลาด อย่าไปยุ่งกับโจรสลัดหนวดขาวนะ
title.x-jat: Kaibutsu Toujou! Shirohige Ichimi ni wa Te o Dasuna

145.overview: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy doesn't let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.
145.summary:
Still searching for a route to the island in the sky, the Straw Hats chart a course for Jaya. Meanwhile, Fire-Fist Ace crashes a party aboard a vessel helmed by Buggy the Pirate!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 夢を見るな! 嘲りの街モックタウン!
title.en: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!
title.fr: Arrêtez de rêver ! Mock Town, la ville méprisante !
title.es: Mock Town, la ciudad donde los sueños no existen
title.ru: Хорош мечтать! Город насмешек Мокк Таун!
title.ar: كفاكم حُلمًا! موكتاون، بلدة السّخرية!
title.th: มองหาความฝันไปทำไม เมืองที่น่ารังเกียจม็อคทาวน์
title.x-jat: Yume o Miruna! Azakeri no Machi Mock Town!

146.overview: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.
146.summary:
The Straw Hats drop anchor at a town overrun by scallywags, so Nami makes the boys swear to stay out of trouble. But when the Bellamy Pirates come looking for a fight, Luffy may have to break his promise!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 海賊の高み! 夢を語る男と海底探索王
title.en: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!
title.fr: Des pirates distingués ! L`homme racontant ses rêves et le roi de la fouille sous-marine
title.es: ¡Los mejores piratas! El hombre que hablaba de sueños y el rey de la exploración submarina
title.ru: Пиратский съезд! Человек, говорящий о мечтах, и король подводной разведки
title.ar: قراصنة في القمّة! رجل يتحدّث عن الأحلام وملك اكتشاف الأعماق!
title.th: ความสูงส่งของโจรสลัด ชายผู้เล่าความฝันและเจ้าแห่งการกู้ซากเรือ
title.x-jat: Kaizoku no Takami! Yume o Kataru Otoko to Kaitei Tansaku Ou

147.overview: Following a fight in the bar, Luffy, Zoro and Nami meet a man outside the bar who tells them that Sky Island does exist. As they leave Mock Town, they get into a fight with Masira's brother Shōjo, another salvage monkey.
147.summary:
Nico`s handy work unearths a solitary dreamer who may know the way to Sky Island. All Luffy and his crew have to do is survive the sonic onslaught of simian salvagers seeking to sink the Going Merry!

He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

Luffy and his mates reach the home of Mont Blanc Cricket: the man with the key to reaching Sky Island. There`s just one tiny problem - he comes from a long line of legendary liars.

Montblanc Cricket agrees to help the Straw Hats reach Sky Island, but first they must venture deep into the darkest depths of a spider-infested forest to capture a mysterious bird with a keen sense of direction.

While the Straw Hats battle creepy-crawly forest creatures on their quest to capture a South Bird, Mont Blanc and his monkey minions are brutally attacked by the Bellamy Pirates!

Luffy turned the other cheek during his first encounter with Bellamy, but now he`s out to settle the score for old man Mont Blanc. Meanwhile, a fearsome pirate crew takes aim at the Straw Hats, eager to earn a bad reputation!

Reaching the sea of clouds proves easier than surviving in it when giant sea creatures attack the Going Merry, Usopp nearly drowns in a cloud, and a strange sky knight issues the Straw Hats a warning!

title.es: ¡Rescatar a un nakama! Incursión en la Franky House
title.ru: Спасти товарища! Рейд на дом Фрэнки
title.ar: إنقاذ صديقنا! غارة على منزل فرانكي!
title.th: ช่วยพวกพ้อง! บุกถล่มแฟรงกกี้เฮ้าส์
title.x-jat: Nakama Kyuushutsu! Nagurikomi Franky House

234.overview: Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him.
234.summary:
Usopp bravely tries to recover the stolen money, but the Franky Family has him badly outnumbered. Zoro, Sanji, and Chopper set out on a rescue mission, but they`ll need Luffy to even the odds!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 月下の大喧嘩! 哀しみに翻る海賊旗!
title.en: Big Fight Under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters with Sorrow!
title.fr: Mutinerie au clair de lune ! Complainte d’un drapeau pirate !
title.es: ¡Gran combate a la luz de la luna! La bandera pirata que ondea tristemente
title.ru: Драка под луной! Слёзы пиратского корабля!
title.ar: قتال كبير تحت ضوء القمر! يرفرف علم القراصنة بحزن!
title.th: แตกคอใต้แสงจันทร์! ธงโจรสลัดที่โบกสะบัดต่อความเศร้า!
title.x-jat: Gekka no Oogenka! Kanashimi ni Hirugaeru Kaizokuki!

235.overview: Once they're back on the ship, Luffy has to finally tell Usopp that the Going Merry can no longer be repaired and that they've chosen to get a new ship without him. Usopp believes that Luffy has abandoned the dignity of their ship and says he's leaving the crew. That night, he challenges Luffy to a duel.
235.summary:
Usopp regains consciousness after his vicious beating, but he`s not at all happy to hear Luffy`s plans for the Going Merry. Temper flares and challenges are issued as the Straw Hats face their most uncertain hour.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルフィVSウソップ! ぶつかる男の意地
title.en: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men`s Pride!
title.fr: Luffy contre Usopp ! Le choc entre deux hommes obstinés !
title.it: Rubber contro Usopp: una questione d`onore
title.es: ¡Luffy vs. Usopp! El temperamento de los hombres que chocan
title.ru: Луффи против Усоппа. Воля сражающихся мужчин
title.ar: لوفي ضدّ أوسوبّ! صدام بين فخر رجلين!
title.th: ทิฐิลูกผู้ชายที่ไม่ลงรอย ลูฟี่ปะทะอุซป
title.x-jat: Luffy VS Usopp! Butsukaru Otoko no Iji

236.overview: Usopp fights Luffy in order to decide who keeps the Going Merry; he fights harder than he's ever fought before. Luffy actually seems to pose no threat but all the while, he's remembering what great friends they used to be, sailing together on the same ship. Even after taking a harsh beating, Luffy defeats Usopp. They leave Usopp and the ship behind.
236.summary:
Luffy and Usopp battle to a brutal standstill in a heartbreaking duel between men who once called each other family. Can the Straw Hats find the strength to carry on without their sniper?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 激震水の都! 狙われたアイスバーグ
title.en: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!
title.fr: La métropole aquatique est sous le choc ! On a tiré sur Icebarg !
title.es: ¡La ciudad de agua tiembla! ¡Iceberg es el objetivo!
title.ru: Город воды в панике. Нападение на Айсберга
title.ar: صدمة قويّة تضرب مدينة المياه! أيسبرغ مستهدف!
title.th: เมืองแห่งน้ำสั่นสะเทือน ไอซ์เบิร์กผู้ถูกหมายหัว
title.x-jat: Gekishin Mizu no Miyako! Nerawareta Iceberg

237.overview: The Strawhats get themselves a hotel room. Nami finds the crew on the roof with urgent news; Iceburg has been shot. As the Galley La Company frantically search for answers, Nami and Luffy decide to check on his condition - only to be met by closed gates. Franky appears then to exact his revenge - with style.
237.summary:
The Straw Hat split is overshadowed by an assassination attempt on the mayor of Water Seven! Luffy is eager to investigate, but the leader of the Franky Family is about to reappear!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ゴムゴム人間VS火を吹く改造人間 [サイボーグ]
title.en: Gum-Gum Human vs. Fire-Breathing Cyborg!
title.fr: L’homme élastique contre le cyborg cracheur de feu !
title.es: Hombre Gomu Gomu vs. Cyborg escupe fuego
title.ru: Резиновый человек против огнедышащего киборга
title.ar: الرّجل المطّاطيّ ضدّ السّايبورغ النّافث للنّار
title.th: มนุษย์ยาง ปะทะ ไซบอร์กพ่นไฟ
title.x-jat: Gomu Gomu Ningen VS Hi o Fuku Cyborg

238.overview: In the streets outside of the hospital, Luffy fights Franky. Inside, Iceburg recalls seeing Nico Robin and another tall man before he was shot. The Galley La company run outside and stop Franky and Luffy and tell them that they suspect the Strawhat Pirates of the crime.
238.summary:
Luffy`s grudge match with Franky gets serious when his opponent turns out to be a cyborg! Iceberg awakes from his slumber only to hurl heinous accusations at the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 犯人は麦わら海賊団? 水の都の用心棒
title.en: The Straw Hat Pirates Are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!
title.fr: Le Chapeau de paille est-il coupable ? Les défenseurs de Water Seven
title.it: Franky contro gli uomini della Galley Company
title.es: ¿Los Sombrero de Paja son los criminales? Los guardianes de la Capital de Agua
title.ru: Преступники – пираты Мугивары? Защитники Water 7
title.ar: قراصنة قبّعة القشّ هم الجناة؟ حُماة مدينة المياه
title.th: คนร้ายคือกลุ่มโจรสลัดหมวกฟาง องค์รักษ์ของเมืองแห่งน้ำออกโรง
title.x-jat: Hannin wa Mugiwara Kaizukudan? Mizu no Miyako no Youjinbou

239.overview: The Galley La Company continues to fight Luffy and Franky is enraged that they've stolen his opponent. An incredibly high tide called the "Aqua Laguna" is coming and Chopper and Sanji rush to warn Usopp. Luffy raises some chaos in order to meet with Iceburg and he demands to know what's happening. Iceburg says he wants to see Robin one more time.
239.summary:
Luffy is branded an assassin and attacked by Iceberg`s strongest men! Meanwhile, Sanji and Chopper attempt to warn Usopp about an impending natural disaster!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 永遠の別れ? 闇を引く女ニコ・ロビン
title.en: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin: The Woman Who Draws Darkness!
title.fr: Des adieux à jamais ? La part d’ombre de Nico Robin
title.es: ¿Despedida final? Nico Robin, la mujer que conlleva oscuridad
title.ru: Расставание навеки? Женщина с тьмой в сердце, Нико Робин
title.ar: وداع أبدي؟ نيكو روبين، المرأة الجاذبة للظلام
title.th: การลาจากตลอดกาล หญิงสาวผู้นำพาความมืด นิโค โรบิ้น
title.x-jat: Eien no Wakare? Yami o Hiku Onna Nico Robin

240.overview: In a bar, Franky talks with Kokoro about her theory on who shot Iceburg. The rumors she speaks of seem to have some truth as we see Robin meeting with someone from an organization called CP9. While the crew hide from angry residents, Sanji and Chopper discover Robin and she tells them what they've feared: she's responsible and she wants to part ways.
240.summary:
The citizens of Water Seven search for the Straw Hats, and a devastating storm threatens to sink the city. Chopper and Sanji pick up Robin`s trail, but they aren`t prepared for what they`ll find.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ロビンを捕まえろ! 麦わら一味の決意
title.en: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!
title.fr: Il faut coincer Robin ! La décision des pirates au chapeau de paille !
title.es: ¡Atrapad a Robin! La decisión de los Sombrero de Paja
title.ru: Поймать Робин! Решение команды Мугивары
title.ar: أمسكوا بروبين! عزيمة طاقم قبعة القش
title.x-jat: Robin o Tsukamaero! Mugiwara Ichimi no Ketsui

241.overview: Chopper reunites with the others without Sanji and they discuss what's happened. Luffy decides that in order to know the full truth, they must catch Robin. Usopp attempts to repair the ship enough to withstand the Aqua Laguna and the Strawhats make their way to the Galley La Company.
241.summary:
Usopp prepares to ride out the storm aboard the Going Merry, Franky hatches a plan to force Luffy into a rematch, and the Straw Hats set out to uncover Robin`s dark secret.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 合図は砲撃と共に! 動き出したCP9
title.en: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!
title.fr: Au signal, à l’explosion ! Le CP9 passe à l’action !
title.es: ¡La explosión es la señal! El CP9 empieza a moverse
title.ru: Взрыв послужит сигналом! CP9 в действии
title.ar: الإشارة هي طلقة المدفع! تحرّك سي بي 9
title.x-jat: Aizu wa Hougeki to Tomoni! Ugokidashita CP9

242.overview: The Strawhats (still missing Sanji) rush to Galley La where Robin and CP9 begin a raid. In Iceburg's room, Robin and the mysterious man Iceburg saw before, tell him that they've purposely placed the blame on the pirates. Their true aim is the blueprints he would've passed down to Paulie. Luffy separates from his group.
242.summary:
Robin and her CP9 brethren seek to settle unfinished business with Iceberg. The Straw Hats have a plan to clear their names, but the assassins are one step ahead of them.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 仮面を取ったCP9! その驚きの素顔
title.en: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!
title.fr: Le CP9 fait tomber les masques ! Des identités stupéfiantes !
title.it: L`identità segreta del CP9 viene smascherata
title.es: ¡CP9 desenmascarado! Las caras de la sorpresa
title.ru: CP9 срывают маски! Шокирующие настоящие лица
title.ar: يخلع سي بي 9 أقنعتهم! وجوههم الحقيقيّة الصاعقة!
title.x-jat: Kamen o Totta CP9! Sono Odoroki no Sugao

243.overview: Robin speaks with Iceburg inside his room still. We already know that Robin can read the poneglyphs - and it seems Iceburg is the one with the blueprints to the ultimate weapon, Pluton. The true enemies are revealed to be Iceburg's own allies. Elsewhere, Luffy is tied up with Paulie after Paulie tells members of CP9 that his blueprints are fake.
243.summary:
Luffy makes his long awaited entrance, Iceberg has a shocking surprise in store for Robin, and the true identities of the masked assassins of CP9 are finally revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 秘めた絆! アイスバーグとフランキー
title.en: Secret Bond! Iceberg and Franky!
title.fr: Un lien secret ! Icebarg et Franky
title.es: ¡El vínculo oculto! Icerbug y Franky
title.ru: Скрытая связь! Айсберг и Фрэнки
title.ar: الرابط السرّي! أيسبرغ وفرانكي
title.x-jat: Himeta Kizuna! Iceberg to Franky

244.overview: Lucci tells Iceburg their hypothesis and has Kaku check his pulse to tell if the things he tells him are true. They suspect that Iceburg's friend from the past, Cutty Flam, is really Franky and it's revealed to be true. Therefore, Franky has the real blueprints. The Strawhat Pirates and Paulie break into the room where they find Iceburg and CP9.
244.summary:
CP9 listens to Iceberg`s blood to learn to the location of the blueprints, Usopp has another run in with Franky, and the remaining Straw Hats – plus a new friend – race to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 帰って来いロビン! CP9との対決!
title.en: Come Back, Robin! Showdown with CP9!
title.fr: Reviens, Robin ! L’affrontement avec le CP9 !
title.es: ¡Regresa, Robin! ¡La confrontación con el CP9!
title.ru: Вернись, Робин! Столкновение с CP9!
title.ar: عودي يا روبين! القتال مع سي بي 9!
title.x-jat: Kaette Koi Robin! CP9 to no Taiketsu!

245.overview: Luffy and the others request that Robin comes back to the crew. She refuses and tells them that she cannot accomplish her "wish" if she were to stay with them. Robin turns to leave and CP9 try to hold the pirates back. Robin successfully escapes and Lucci shows those remaining his "transformation".
245.summary:
Luffy and the gang come face to face with Robin and her CP9 comrades. The rubberman is prepared to fight for his friend, but he`s never faced foes like this!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 麦わら海賊団全滅? モデル豹[レオパルド]の脅威!
title.en: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!
title.fr: L’équipage au chapeau de paille décimé ? La menace du modèle Léopard
title.it: Il CP9 in cerca di Franky
title.es: ¿Aniquilación de los piratas de Sombrero de Paja? ¡El terror del Modelo Leopardo!
title.ru: Крах Мугивары? Террор модели Леопард!
title.ar: القضاء على قراصنة قبّعة القشّ؟ تهديد صنف النّمر المرقّط!
title.x-jat: Mugiwara Kaizoku Dan Zenmetsu? Model Leopard no Kyoui

246.overview: Lucci's transformation is a result of a Devil's Fruit; a Zoan Type leopard. He quickly disposes of the crew and CP9 tie up Paulie and Iceburg, leaving them alone as the building slowly burns down around them. In Franky's underground hideout, Usopp tells him his story and Franky is finally touched. In return, Franky tells him a little about Tom's contributions to Water 7.
246.summary:
Luffy, Zoro, and Nami are sent hurtling toward their deaths by the villains of CP9! Meanwhile, Usopp forges an unlikely friendship with Franky while waiting out a storm.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 船からも愛された男! ウソップの涙!
title.en: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp`s Tears!
title.fr: L’amour entre un homme et son bateau ! Les larmes d’Usopp !
title.es: ¡El hombre que ama su barco! ¡Las lágrimas de Usopp!
title.ru: Его любит корабль! Слёзы Усоппа!
title.ar: الرّجل الّذي يحظى بحبّ حتّى سفينته! دموع أوسوبّ!
title.x-jat: Fune kara mo Aisareta Otoko! Usopp no Namida!

247.overview: Usopp believes that the person who repaired the Going Merry in Skypeia was really the Going Merry itself. Franky says that the ship was inhabited by a spirit who enters ships who are dearly cared for. The spirit repaired their ship just enough for them to reach the next island. The doorbell rings from the sea side and the Galley La foremen enter.
247.summary:
Franky tries to convince Usopp that there`s no hope for the Going Merry, but the sniper - inspired by a mysterious moment from the past - remains loyal to his beloved boat
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: フランキーの過去! 海列車が走った日
title.en: Franky`s Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!
title.fr: Le passé de Franky ! Le jour où le train des mers a démarré !
title.es: ¡El pasado de Franky! El día en que el Umi Ressha partió
title.ru: Прошлое Фрэнки! День, когда морепоезд пошёл
title.ar: ماضي فرانكي! اليوم الّذي اشتغل فيه قطار البحر أوّل مرّة!
title.x-jat: Franky no Kako! Umi Ressha ga Hashitta Hi

248.overview: The foremen discover Franky's hidden room and he fears they'll trample his memories. A long flashback ensues, covering Franky's past in Tom's Workers and how he and Iceburg helped create the Sea Train.
248.summary:
A look back at Franky`s past reveals the amazing origins of the sea train – and paints a vivid picture of his younger days, spent alongside Iceberg and the legendary shipwright Tom!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: スパンダムの陰謀! 海列車が揺れた日
title.en: Spandam`s Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!
title.fr: Le complot de Spandam. Le jour où le train des mers a vacillé
title.es: ¡La conspiración de Spandam! El día en que el Umi Ressha tembló
title.ru: Конспирация Спандама! День, когда морепоезд вздрогнул
title.ar: مخطّط سباندام! اليوم الّذي اهتزّ فيه القطار!
title.x-jat: Spandum no Inbou! Umi Ressha ga Yureta Hi

249.overview: Spandam, a CP5 representative, was determined to get Tom proven guilty in his trial so he could get the blueprints. As Franky walked into the town, people from the government began to attack with the battleships he had personally constructed. Tom and Iceburg run to their shipyard where they're attacked by two ships which also destroy the others. Iceburg tells Franky that he has to take responsibility or he'll never forgive him.
249.summary:
Franky`s backstory continues! The sea train is a success, and it looks like Tom`s life is spared! Unfortunately, a government spy is searching for a reason to investigate Tom, and Franky provides the ammunition!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 伝説の男の最後! 海列車が泣いた日
title.en: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!
title.fr: La fin d’un homme légendaire ! Le jour où le train des mers a pleuré
title.es: ¡El final de un hombre legendario! El día en que el Umi Ressha lloró
title.ru: Смерть человека-легенды! День, когда морепоезд рыдал
title.ar: نهاية الرّجل الأسطوريّ! اليوم الّذي بكى فيه قطار البحر!
title.x-jat: Densetsu no Otoko no Saigo! Umi Ressha ga Naita Hi

250.summary:
Tom does the unthinkable in an attempt to protect his apprentices, but young Franky is unable to control his rage, leading to a showdown with a spy - and a train!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 裏切りの真相! ロビンの哀しき決意!
title.en: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin`s Sorrowful Decision!
title.fr: La vérité derrière la trahison ! Le douloureux choix de Robin !
title.es: ¡La verdad tras la traición! ¡La dolorosa decisión de Robin!
title.ru: Причина предательства. Нелёгкое решение Робин
title.ar: حقيقة خيانتها! قرار روبين المحزن!
title.x-jat: Uragiri no Shinsou! Robin no Kanashiki Ketsui!

251.summary:
Chopper`s heroism may mean the difference between life and death for Iceberg and Paulie, Nami learns the agonizing truth about Robin, and Sanji prepares to make his move!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 仲間を引き離す汽笛! 走り出す海列車
title.en: The Steam Whistle Forces Friends Apart! The Sea Train Starts to Run!
title.fr: Le train des mers sifflera une fois ! Des amis qui se séparent
title.es: ¡El silbato de vapor separa a los nakamas! El Umi Ressha se pone en marcha
title.ru: Гудок, разделивший накама! Уходящий морепоезд
title.ar: تجبر صافرة البّخارِ الأصدقاءَ على الفراق! يبدأ القطار البحريّ بالمسير!
title.x-jat: Nakama o Hikihanasu Kiteki! Hashiridasu Umi Ressha

252.overview: Paulie helps clear the name of the Strawhats but doesn't tell the mob everything he knows. He gets the mob to follow Chopper so they can search for the rest of the crew. Nami goes her own way so she can rush to the Sea Train. As Nami nears the station, Sanji, ahead of her, approaches the train.
252.summary:
Nami makes a frantic dash for the Sea Train station, Chopper searches desperately for Zoro and Luffy, and Sanji plays it cool while waiting for the right time to spring into action.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: サンジ突入! 嵐の中の海列車バトル!
title.en: Sanji Barges In! Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
title.fr: Sanji s`est infiltré ! Le train des mers dans la tempête !
title.es: ¡Sanji irrumpe! ¡Batalla en el Umi Ressha bajo la tormenta!
title.ru: Санджи Идёт на штурм! Битва в шторм на морепоезде!
title.ar: اقتحام سانجي! معركة القطار البحريّ في العاصفة!
title.x-jat: Sanji Totsunyuu! Arashi no Naka no Umiressha Battle!

253.overview: Nami and the conductors are rescued by Paulie when the Aqua Laguna floods the main station. A man hands Nami a letter he found from Sanji. It informs her that Usopp, Franky, and he are on board the train that had just departed. On board, he storms the cars. High up in the city, Nami speaks with Kokoro and spots Luffy, stuck in between two buildings, in the back streets where the Aqua Laguna will hit first.
253.summary:
Nami arrives at the train station a minute too late, Sanji makes his presence aboard the sea train known, and the search for Luffy and Zoro continues!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ナミ魂の叫び! 麦わらのルフィ復活!
title.en: Nami`s Soul Cries Out! Straw Hat Luffy Makes a Comeback!
title.fr: Nami crie de toute son âme ! Le retour de Luffy au chapeau de paille !
title.es: ¡El grito del alma de Nami! ¡El renacer de Luffy Sombrero de Paja!
title.ru: Крик, идущий из сердца Нами! Возвращение Мугивары Луффи!
title.ar: صرخة نامي من الرّوح! عودة قبّعة القشّ لوفي!
title.x-jat: Nami Tamashii no Sakebi! Mugiwara no Luffy Fukkatsu!

254.overview: Nami finally reaches Luffy and tells him that he needs to hurry before Robin reaches Enies Lobby. Chopper finds Zoro and hands him the Sandai Kitetsu so he can escape the chimney. Luffy pushes apart the buildings he was stuck between and Paulie grabs them all so they can escape the Aqua Laguna's massive wave.
254.summary:
Chopper and Nami risk their own lives in a desperate attempt to save Luffy and Zoro from a monstrous wall of water! Meanwhile, Sanji moves ever closer to a reunion with Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: もう一つの海列車! ロケットマン出撃
title.en: Another Sea Train? Rocketman Charges Forth!
title.fr: Un autre train des mers ? Le départ du Rocketman !
title.es: ¿Otro Umi Ressha? Partida del Rocket Man
title.ru: Еще один морепоезд? Вылазка Рокетмена!
title.ar: قطار بحريّ آخر؟ يتقدّم قطار الرّجل الصّارخ للأمام
title.x-jat: Mouhitotsu no Umi Ressha! Rocketman Shutsugeki

255.overview: Sanji fights his way through another train car and finds Usopp and Franky. Seeing how determined Luffy is to save Robin, Kokoro and Iceburg lends the Strawhat crew the use of another sea train, Rocket Man. The Franky Family shows up, pleading with Luffy to let them join them because they'll do anything for their leader.
255.summary:
Luffy and Nami ask to borrow a ship so they can chase down the sea train, but the weather is too severe to set sail. Lucky for them, Iceberg and his friends are full of surprises!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 仲間を救え! 拳に誓った敵同士の絆!
title.en: Rescue Our Friends! A Bond Among Foes Sworn with Fists!
title.fr: Au secours de nos amis ! Pacte entre ennemis, à la force des poings !
title.es: ¡Rescatar a nuestros nakamas! ¡Enemigos mutuos unidos por el juramento de una alianza!
title.ru: Спасти Накама! Враг моего врага – мой друг!
title.ar: إنقاذ أصدقائنا! رابط بين الأعداء أقسم عليه بالقبضات!
title.x-jat: Nakama o Sukue! Kobushi ni Chikatta Tekidoushi no Kizuna!

256.overview: The Rocket Man finally makes it out to sea. As the train connects with the tracks, Luffy has to rescue Chimney before she's thrown off by the wind. In the meanwhile, Iceburg has a flashback about when he finally met Franky again in Water 7. With Luffy and Chimney safe in the train, Paulie tells his fellow carpenters who the real culprits were. The Strawhats, Franky Family, and Galley La Company form an alliance.
256.summary:
Luffy, Zoro, Chopper, and Nami rocket toward a rendezvous with the assassins of CP 9, but they`ll need to forge an alliance with some new friends to have any chance at survival!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 波を砕け! ルフィとゾロの最強合体技[コンボ]
title.en: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro Use the Strongest Combo!
title.fr: Une brèche dans la vague ! Le combo ultime : Luffy et Zoro
title.it: Rubber e Zoro contro la grande onda
title.es: ¡Romper la ola! El combo más fuerte de Luffy y Zoro
title.ru: Сквозь волны! Могучее комбо Луффи и Зоро
title.ar: اسحقوا الموجة! هجوم لوفي وزورو الثّنائيّ الأقوى
title.x-jat: Nami o Kudake! Luffy to Zoro no Saikyou Combo

257.overview: Luffy and Zoro perform a move that acts similar to a cannon and blasts a hole through the wall of the tidal wave ahead of them, opening up a channel for them to pass through. They miraculously pass through unscathed and the passengers rejoice. Sanji contacts the rest of the crew and fills them in on his current situation. Usopp separates from them but later, when Sanji and Franky are spotted, a man named Sogeking comes to their rescue.
257.summary:
Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji`s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky`s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 謎の男登場!? その名はそげキング!
title.en: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
title.fr: Un homme mystérieux entre en scène ! Son nom est Sniperking !
title.es: ¿¡Aparece un hombre misterioso!? ¡Su nombre es Sogeking!
title.ru: Герой из ниоткуда?! Его зовут Согекинг!
title.ar: ظهور رجل غامض؟! اسمه هو سوغيكينغ!
title.x-jat: Nazo no Otoko Toujou!? Sono Na wa Sogeking!

258.overview: Sogeking makes his grand entrance. Franky and Sanji aren't fooled by his costume but they try to humor him. They devise a plan first, then detach the last two cars and fight their way through the rest. Back in the Rocket Man, Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Chopper get an outfit change; Nami shows off the weapon Usopp upgraded for her while he was still with them.
258.summary:
Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: コック対決! サンジVSラーメン拳法
title.en: Showdown Between Cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo
title.fr: Duel de chefs ! Sanji contre l`art martial des nouilles !
title.es: ¡Confrontación de cocineros! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo
title.ru: Битва коков! Санджи против Раменного Кемпо
title.ar: صراع بين طباخين! سانجي ضد كينبو الرامين!
title.x-jat: Kokku Taiketsu! Sanji vs Ramen Kenpou

259.overview: Kalifa updates the CP9 on the situation with Franky, Sanji, and Usopp. Sanji tells Franky and Usopp to go on without him so he can fight Wanze and his "Ramen Kenpo". Franky begins to fight Nero, CP9's "Weasel", and Sogeking meets with Robin.
259.summary:
Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 屋根の上の決闘! フランキーVSネロ
title.en: Rooftop Duel! Franky vs. Nero!
title.fr: Combat sur le toit ! Franky contre Nero !
title.es: ¡Duelo en el techo! Franky vs. Nero
title.ru: Дуэль на крыше! Фрэнки против Неро
title.ar: قتال فوق السطح! فرانكي ضد نيرو
title.x-jat: Yane no Ue no Kettou! Franky VS Nero

260.overview: Franky's fight with Nero continues. Nero discovers that Franky's weak spot is his back, so Franky lies down flat so he can't get to it. Nero demands that he fight seriously, so Franky gets up to perform his "Centaur" form. Sogeking talks with Robin and tells her that the crew knows about her reasons for leaving. Those on the Rocket Man encounter the discarded cars and Zoro slices them so they can pass.
260.summary:
Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 激突! 鬼斬りゾロVS船斬りTボーン
title.en: Clash! Demon-Slasher Zoro vs. Ship-Slasher T-Bone!
title.fr: Gare à la collision ! Le Demon Slash de Zoro contre le Boat Slash de T-Bone !
title.es: ¡Enfrentamiento! Zoro el corta demonios vs. T-Bone el corta barcos
title.ru: Ярость! Дьявольский резак Зоро против Корабельного рубаки Тибона
title.ar: اصطدام! القاطع الشيطاني زورو. ضد قاطع السفن تي-بون!
title.x-jat: Gekitotsu! Onigiri Zoro VS Funekiri T-Bone

261.overview: Zoro clashes with "Ship Cutter" T-Bone. The fight is short and Zoro joins the crew again in the Rocket Man. On the Puffing Tom, Sanji beats Wanze beautiful, though Wanze thinks he's ruined his face. Franky finally gains the upper hand against Nero and defeats him. After beating their respective opponents, Franky and Sanji stand to fight against the other CP9.
261.summary:
Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight with against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ロビン争奪戦! そげキングの奇策!!
title.en: Scramble Over Robin! A Cunning Plan by Sogeking!
title.fr: Bataille pour reprendre Robin ! L`ingénieux stratagème de Sniperking !
title.es: ¡La lucha de Robin! ¡¡El ingenioso plan de Sogeking!!
title.ru: Сопротивление Робин. Хитрый план Согекинга
title.ar: تهافت على روبين. خطّة سوغيكينغ الماكرة
title.x-jat: Robin Soudatsusen! Sogeking no Kisaku!!

262.overview: After hiding under Robin's cloak for a few episodes, Sogeking finally shows himself. They stumble into the room with the CP9 and meet with Sanji and Franky. Sogeking produces a smokescreen. The four head into another car, detach it, and escape. It's not long before Blueno pulls their car back, though. Franky knocks down the wall so they can escape but ends up on the enemy car. Blueno opens a door then back in the Strawhat car.
262.summary:
The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 司法の島! エニエス・ロビーの全貌!
title.en: The Judicial Island! Full View of Enies Lobby!
title.fr: L`île judiciaire ! Panorama d`Enies Lobby !
title.es: ¡La Isla Judicial! ¡Panorámica de Enies Lobby!
title.ru: Судебный остров! Панорама Эниэс Лобби!
title.ar: الجزيرة القضائيّة! المنظر الكامل لإنيس لوبي!
title.x-jat: Shihou no Shima! Enies Lobby no Zenbou!

263.overview: Robin willingly follows Blueno into his improvised door and Sogeking and Sanji are left alone. For a while, Blueno explains a little of Robin's past involving the Buster Call. Back at the Rocket Man, Yokuzuna the frog jumps onto the front of the train, knocking them from the rails. After Kokoro speaks with him, he joins the group. The CP9, Franky, and Robin finally reach Enies Lobby and disembark.
263.summary:
As their train approaches Enies Lobby, Franky`s kind words cut through Robin`s cold exterior. Luffy`s train is thrown off course, but the group gains a powerful new ally!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 上陸作戦始動! 麦わら一味突入せよ!
title.en: Landing Operations Start! Charge in, Straw Hats!
title.fr: Opération débarquement ! Les pirates au chapeau de paille foncent dans le tas !
title.es: ¡Empieza El Desembarco! ¡Llegan Los Del Sombrero de Paja!
title.ru: Прибытие! Команда Соломенной Шляпы – на штурм!
title.ar: بدء خطّة الرسو! اقتحموا يا طاقم قبعة القش!
title.x-jat: Jouriku Sakusen Shidou! Mugiwara Ichimi Totsunyuu Seyo!

264.overview: The Straw Hats and their allies are about to reach Enies Lobby. Galley-La foreman Paulie sketches the island's terrain and explains that, to save Robin, the crew must reach her before she passes through the Gate of Justice. Because the Straw Hats are the only ones capable of matching the CP9 in combat, the Franky Family and the Galley-La foremen plan to charge in first and open the island's gates to allow the Straw Hats to rush in riding the sea train. As Enies Lobby draws near, the gigantic Gate of Justice appears in the sky behind it. While his crewmates and allies gaze in awe, Luffy ignores the plan and strides past the first of the gates. On the other side of the island, in the Tower of Justice, Chief Spandam and the second half of CP9 await the arrival of Rob Lucci's group and their prisoners.
264.summary:
The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can`t wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルフィ快進撃! 司法の島で大決戦!!
title.en: Luffy Cuts Through! Big Showdown on the Judicial Island!
title.fr: Luffy débarque ! Grande bataille sur l`île judiciaire !
title.es: ¡Luffy a la carga! ¡¡Gran batalla decisiva en la Isla Judicial!!
title.ru: Луффи прорывается внутрь! Яростная битва на судебном острове!!
title.ar: اختراق لوفي! مواجهة كبيرة على الجزيرة القضائيّة!
title.x-jat: Luffy Kaishingeki! Shihou no Shima de Daikessen!!

265.overview: Luffy easily gets past the second gate, while the Franky Family and the Galley-La foremen, following their initial plan, break the first gate's defenses. All goes smoothly at first, but by the time the Franky Family's main force reaches the second gate, the marines have called for help. The giants Oimo and Kāshī, the island's front gate gatekeepers, take up their posts. Overmatched in strength and size, the Franky Family send their best fighters, the Kairiki Destroyers. However, even these overly large humans can do little against the giants' power and are quickly defeated. On the other side of the gate, Luffy faces the collective might of Enies Lobby's 10,000 men.
265.summary:
Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family`s assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 巨人族との攻防! 第二の扉を開けろ!
title.en: Battle Against Giants! Open the Second Gate!
title.fr: Combat contre les géants ! Ouvrez la deuxième porte !
title.es: ¡Batalla contra los gigantes! ¡Abramos la segunda puerta!
title.ru: Битва с гигантами! Открыть Вторые врата!
title.ar: قتال ضدّ عملاقين افتحوا البوّابة الثانية!
title.x-jat: Kyojinzoku to no Koubou! Daini no Tobira o Akero!

266.overview: The Galley-La foremen and the leading members of the Franky Family arrive late at the second gate because they had to mount the Franky Family's king bulls, sea dwelling animals that look like sea horses, on caterpillar tracks. Combining forces, they manage to pin down Kāshī against a wall. Then, taunting Oimo, they goad him into hitting his partner in the face, knocking Kāshī unconscious. In the Tower of Justice, Spandam receives an incomplete report about Luffy, which leads him to believe that the enemy captain is not a threat. Lucci's party arrives and the CP9 celebrate their reunion with petty bickering and a contest of strength. Meanwhile, Luffy, defying resistance, makes his way towards the Courthouse Plaza.
266.summary:
Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 活路を開け! 空を飛ぶロケットマン!
title.en: Find a Way Out! Rocketman Takes Flight!
title.fr: Ouvrez le passage ! L`envol du Rocketman !
title.es: ¡La vía de escape se abre! ¡Vuela por el cielo, Rocket Man!
title.ru: Открыть путь спасения! Полёт Рокетмэна!
title.ar: جدوا مخرجًا! طيران الرجل الصاروخ!
title.x-jat: Katsuro o Hirake! Sora o Tobu Rocketman!

267.overview: Robin and Franky are brought before Spandam, while Luffy blasts through waves of marines. The Galley-La foremen and the Franky Family eventually slip by Oimo and open the second gate. However, their joy is short-lived, as a group of marines closes the first gate behind them. To overcome the unanticipated obstacle, Zoro changes the plan. Yokozuna bends the island's outside fence downward. Using it as a ramp, the sea train jumps over both of the gates and crash lands into Oimo's back, finishing him off, and concluding everyone's arrival at the main island. As the elite group—called Law's Watch Dog Unit—enters the fight on the side of the marines, the battle escalates in intensity.
267.summary:
Zoro`s quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルフィに追いつけ! 麦わら一味総力戦
title.en: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hats` All-Out Battle
title.fr: A la poursuite de Luffy ! L`équipage de chapeau de paille au combat !
title.es: ¡Reunámonos con Luffy! ¡La guerra total de los piratas de Sombrero de Paja!
title.ru: Догнать Луффи! Полномасштабное наступление Мугивар
title.ar: الحقوا بلوفي! معركة طاقم قبعة القش الشاملة!
title.x-jat: Luffy ni Oitsuke! Mugiwara Ichimi Souryokusen

268.overview: The Straw Hats struggle to catch up with Luffy, but get caught up in impeding each other's efforts; Sanji and Zoro indulge themselves in petty bickering and Nami injures her crewmates by testing her newly improved weapon. The streets appear empty, abandoned by the men who were fighting Luffy. Just then, the Law's Watch Dog Unit and a large group of other men step into their way. A fight seems inevitable until their allies, riding the king bulls, arrive. Paulie uses his ropes to pull the crew onto the back of one of the large animals. Then the Galley-La foremen replace Straw Hats' in battle to allow the rest of the group to escape.
268.summary:
Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 裏切られたロビン! 世界政府の思惑!
title.en: Robin Betrayed! The Motive of the World Government!
title.fr: Robin est trahie ! Les espérance du gouvernement mondial
title.es: ¡Robin ha sido traicionada! ¡Las expectativas del Gobierno Mundial!
title.ru: Робин предали. Замыслы мирового правительства
title.ar: روبين المغدورة! دافع حكومة العالم!
title.x-jat: Uragirareta Robin! Sekai Seifu no Omowaku!

269.overview: Spandam tells Robin that her crew has come to save her and that he, despite the agreement between her and the CP9, plans on taking them prisoner. On the main road, the Straw Hats and the Franky Family proceed towards the Courthouse Plaza. Chopper talks with the king bull named Sodom, who notes that Sogeking did not make it onto his back. Meanwhile, frustrated with his inability to move forward, Luffy slingshots himself onto the courthouse. There, Blueno is awaiting his arrival.
269.summary:
Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ロビンを返せ! ルフィVSブルーノ!
title.en: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
title.fr: Rendez-nous Robin ! Luffy contre Blueno !
title.es: ¡Devolvednos a Robin! ¡Luffy contra Blueno!
title.ru: Верните Робин! Луффи против Бруно!
title.ar: أعيدوا روبين! لوفي ضد بلونو!
title.x-jat: Robin o Kaese! Luffy VS Blueno!

270.overview: Oimo explains to Sogeking about how he and Kāshī came to support the marines—the marines told them that they arrested their bosses. The story reminds Sogeking of the giants Dorry and Broggy, whom the Straw Hats met shortly after entering the Grand Line. Sodom the king bull incurs severe damage and urges the Straw Hats riding him to continue without him. Quickly, they board Sodom's brother Gomorrah and continue on. Atop of the courthouse, the fight between Blueno and Luffy begins. Luffy throws the first punch and seems far less inferior than during their last encounter.
270.summary:
