Source: crunchyroll

title.fr: Chopperman entre en action ! Il faut protéger la chaîne de télévision en bord de plage
title.es: ¡Chopperman en marcha! Proteged la costa de la emisora de TV
title.ru: Чоппермэн отбывает! Защитить ТВ-станцию

title.x-jat: Shutsudou Chopperman! Mamore Nagisa no TV-kyoku

336.overview: Chopperman and Namifia are low on money! Dr. Usodabada constructs a plan to bring down Chopperman while collecting fame for himself and a new crew to replace his nonhelpful duo—Sanjilops and Zorogilla. His plan—to take over the TV Station and televise his demands. Not that anyone really cares except Chopperman, who only wants to join for the rare Air Force C-Max Collectors item. After a wrestling match between the two, and even a mecha battle, the evil Doctor is defeated, and Chopperman reaches celebrity status!
336.summary:
The most adorable hero the world has ever known - Chopperman - must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite television station!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魔の海突入! 霧に浮かぶ謎のガイコツ
title.en: Plunging into the Devil`s Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating in the Fog!
title.fr: Entrée sur la mer du diable ! Le mystérieux squelette flottant dans la brume

title.ru: Вторжение в море дьявола! Загадочный скелет, плывущий сквозь туман

337.overview: In search of food, the Straw Hats attempt octopus hunting before discovering a barrel in the middle of the ocean. After opening the barrel, Thousand Sunny gets thrown into the foggy Florian Triangle where it encounters a ruined ship and a skeleton man named Brook, whom Luffy immediately asks to join the crew.
337.summary:
While sailing through haunted waters, the Straw Hats encounter a ghost ship that`s home to a walking, talking skeleton!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 人に逢えた喜び! ガイコツ紳士の正体

title.fr: Quelle joie de voir des gens ! La vraie nature du gentleman squelette
title.es: ¡El placer de encontrar a gente! Los auténticos sentimientos del esqueleto caballeroso
title.ru: Радость встречи с людьми! Истинное лицо скелета-джентльмена
title.ar: فرحة رؤية النّاس! هويّة الهيكل العظميّ المحترم الحقيقيّة
title.x-jat: Hito ni Aeta Yorokobi! Gaikotsu Shinshi no Shoutai

338.overview: Onboard the Thousand Sunny, Brook tells his story of being a musician before being killed. However, his spirit was able to reanimate his skeleton due to the power of the Revive Revive Fruit. He also tells of having his shadow stolen, and thus cannot be out in open sunlight. A ghost suddenly appears in the galley, and the Straw Hats find out that they have been targeted by the ghost isle Thriller Bark, which has found them.
338.summary:
The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade, but the skeleton`s sad story is interrupted by a ghastly landing at the haunted island of Thriller Bark!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 怪現象ぞくぞく! スリラーバーク上陸
title.en: One Unnatural Phenomenon After the Next! Disembarking on Thriller Bark!
title.fr: Les phénomènes étranges se succèdent ! Débarquement à Thriller Bark
title.es: ¡Un fenómeno tras otro! ¡Desembarco en Thriller Bark!
title.ru: Загадка за загадкой! Высадка на Триллер Барк
title.ar: ظاهرة غير طبيعيّة تلو الأخرى! النّزل إلى ثريلر بارك
title.x-jat: Kai Genshou Zokuzoku! Thriller Bark Jouriku

339.overview: Brook bids farewell to the Straw Hats and leaps overboard, revealing that he can dash across the ocean's surface. Nami, Usopp, and Chopper sail out to explore the island using the Mini-Merry II, and encounter a cerberus. Back on the ship, the remaining crew members are harassed by an invisible creature. After fleeing the cerberus, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper encounter Hildon, a vampiric creature who offers to take them to the mansion of Doctor Hogback.
339.summary:
After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 天才と呼ばれた男! ホグバック現る!

title.fr: Cet homme est un génie, à ce qu`on dit. Hogback se manifeste
title.es: ¡El hombre llamado genio! ¡Hogback aparece!
title.ru: Человек, названный гением! Появление Хогбака!
title.ar: الرّجل الملقّب بالعبقريّ! ظهور هوغباك!
title.x-jat: Tensai to Yobareta Otoko! Hogback Arawaru!

340.overview: Usopp, Nami and Chopper traverse through the forest of Thriller Bark, where they are attacked by a platoon of zombies before finally reaching the mansion of the bizarre surgeon Doctor Hogback and his female assistant Victoria Cindry. While immediately hospitable, the doctor starts acting strange after it is mentioned that Brook has arrived on the island. The Thousand Sunny, meanwhile, gets caught in a giant spiderweb.
340.summary:
Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!
Source: crunchyroll

title.es: ¡Nami en serios apuros! La mansión zombi y el hombre invisible

title.ar: نامي في ورطة كبيرة! قصر الزّومبي والرّجل الخفيّ!
title.x-jat: Nami Dai Pinch! Zombie Yashiki to Toumei Ningen

341.overview: After the meeting with Hogback, Nami is assaulted by an invisible creature in the shower, but Usopp and Chopper manage to drive it off. The rest of the Straw Hats set foot on the island and encounter more zombies. Elsewhere, Hogback meets with Absalom, the invisible man who attacked Nami, and a ghost referred to as Perona, to discuss what to do with the Straw Hats. Back in the manor, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper find themselves surrounded and trapped by the Surprise Zombies: zombies that strike from paintings, taxidermied heads, and even floor rugs.
341.summary:
An invisible man turns Nami`s bath time into a harrowing experience, and Usopp battles a hall full of haunted paintings with a handful of burning candles!
Source: crunchyroll

title.es: ¡El zombi misterioso! ¡La sala de investigaciones del diabólico Hogback!

title.ar: !سرّ الزّومبي! مختبر هوغباك الكابوسيّ
title.x-jat: Zombie no Nazo! Akumu no Hogback Kenkyuujo

342.overview: Escaping from the Surprise Zombies of the mansion, Nami, Chopper and Usopp discover the truth about Victoria Cindry's true identity and Doctor Hogback's experiments before being approached by a mysterious samurai zombie with Brook's voice. Meanwhile, Luffy's group are ambushed by ghosts who make them become depressed but then depart. They destroy a platoon of outside zombies with a group team attack.
342.summary:
While Usopp, Nami, and Chopper seek to unravel the secrets of the haunted mansion, Luffy and the gang do battle with an army of the undead!
Source: crunchyroll

343.overview: After beating the zombies, the Straw Hats learn that one of the Shichibukai, Gecko Moria, has been stealing people's shadows and using them to revive zombies. After they leave, Absalom rallies the zombies together for the Night Attack, while the ghosts from before return to their master, a Gothic Lolita-style Ghost Princess Perona. Gecko Moria himself, a massive, giant-like man, is awoken. The Straw Hats come to the realization that Thriller Bark is not an island, but rather, a massive ship!
343.summary:
Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!
Source: crunchyroll

344.overview: Usopp, Nami and Chopper are effortlessly incapacitated by the General Zombie Ryuuma, a samurai with an eerie resemblance to Brook, and are locked inside a coffin. Luffy and the others enter the mansion and defeat the Surprise Zombies with ease, but Sanji goes missing, so they force Buhichuck to act as their guide by taking him with them. While the zombies of Thriller Bark celebrate the start of the Night Attack, Absalom awakens the other General Zombies to handle the Straw Hats.
344.summary:
Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!
Source: crunchyroll

345.summary:
After escaping from their coffin prison, Usopp, Chopper, and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals!
Source: crunchyroll

346.summary:
An undead warthog sets her sights on Nami, Zorro and Sanji vanish without a trace, Franky and Robin battle an unbeatable army, and Luffy gets captured!
Source: crunchyroll

347.summary:
A penguin zombie starts acting an awful lot like Sanji, Nami continues running for her life, and Robin and Franky buy some time by blowing up a bridge!
Source: crunchyroll

348.summary:
Nami gives love advice to a zombie, Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria, and Robin gets caught in spooky spider web. Things look bleak for the Straw Hats until their skeleton friend lends a hand!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルフィ緊急事態! 最強の影の行き先!

349.overview: After finishing off General Talaran, Brook reveals the mysteries behind Thriller Bark. Elsewhere, Moria gathers the Mysterious Three and attempts to capture Luffy's shadow.
349.summary:
Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria`s devious plan is revealed, and Luffy`s escape attempt leads to the loss of something he can`t live without!
Source: crunchyroll

350.overview: Moria and the others begin the revival of number 900 - Oz. Meanwhile, Franky and Robin learn more of Brook's past and their future mission.
350.summary:
Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy`s shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 500年ぶりの目覚め!! オーズ開眼!!

351.summary:
Luffy`s shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 信念の命乞い!! アフロを守るブルック

352.overview: After Oz eats his full, will he obey Moria? Elsewhere, as Brook prepares to fight Ryuuma a second time, he recalls his first encounter with him five years earlier.
352.summary:
Gecko Moria`s minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy`s shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 男の誓いは死なず!! 遠い空で待つ友へ

title.fr: La promesse d’un homme ne meurt jamais ! Pour toi, mon ami qui m’attends au loin

353.overview: Usopp and the others return to the Sunny in search of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji. When they arrive, they discover the trio unconscious. After waking them up, Usopp and Franky each share what they have discovered. But, Franky has a shocking story about Brook's promise to his nakama. Meanwhile, Nami's wedding with Absalom draws near.
353.summary:
The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook`s story about a promise he made to a very special whale!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 必ず会いに行く!! ブルックと約束の岬
title.en: I Swear to Go See Him!! Brook and the Cape of Promise!
title.fr: Je reviendrai te voir, sois en sûr ! Brook et le cap de la promesse
title.es: ¡Nos volveremos a encontrar sin falta! Brook y el Cabo de la Promesa

title.ar: أقسم أنّني سأذهب وأراه! بروك ورأس الوعد
title.x-jat: Kanarazu Ai ni Iku!! Brook to Yakusoku no Misaki

354.overview: After learning that Brook's nakama is Laboon the whale, Luffy is dead-set on recruiting him. Before they prepare to take down Thriller Bark and regain their shadows, Sanji tells Chopper, Robin, and Franky the story of Laboon and the Twin Capes.
354.summary:
Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook`s battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: メシとナミと影!! ルフィ怒りの大反撃
title.en: Food, Nami, and Shadows!! Luffy`s Enraged Counterattack!
title.fr: L`essentiel à sauver : La bouffe, Nami, nos ombres. La contre-attaque rageuse de Luffy

355.overview: With their goals in mind, Luffy, Sanji, Robin, Usopp, and Chopper go after Nami and Moria! Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro head toward Brook. However, Hildon tells the others of the Straw Hat's plan.
355.summary:
Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami`s zombie wedding before it`s too late!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ウソップ最強? ネガティブは任せとけ

title.x-jat: Usopp Saikyou? Negative wa Makasetoke

356.overview: Luffy continues on to take on Moria while Chopper and Robin remain behind to take on Hogback and his loyal zombie servants. After Oars runs off with a new pirate hat from his destruction, the remainder of the crew end up in Perona's room where she uses her negative powers on them. However, Usopp reveals that he's immune to her attacks because he's already got a negative personality, staying behind to take on the ghost princess while the others continue towards Absalom and Ryuuma.
356.summary:
Usopp`s naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona`s depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 将軍[ジェネラル]ゾンビ瞬殺!! オーズは冒険気分!!
title.en: The General Zombies Are Down in a Flash!! Oars Feels Like an Adventure!!

title.es: ¡Muerte repentina de los generales zombies! ¡Oz con ganas de aventuras!

357.overview: Usopp continues to stand up to Perona's Negative Hollows while wiping out Wild Zombies, while Brook is held at the mercy of Ryuma, who finally proves his superiority over the original by defeating the skeleton in battle before the arrival of Zoro. Meanwhile, Oars continues to cause chaos on Thriller Bark, forcing Absalom to send his entire General Zombie audience to stop him. But Oars annihilates all of them with a "non-Gum-Gum" Gatling, leaving their boss at the mercy of the newly arriving Sanji.
357.summary:
When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!
Source: crunchyroll
