title.fr: Sanji, le chevalier enflammé ! Un bon coup de pied dans cette fausse cérémonie !
title.es: ¡El caballero envuelto en llamas, Sanji! Destrozando a patadas la falsa ceremonia
title.ru: Санджи – огненный рыцарь!! Отмени ложную церемонию
title.ar: الفارس المشتعل سانجي! أسقط الزّفاف الزّائف!
title.x-jat: Honoo no Knight Sanji!! Keritsubuse Itsuwari no Kyoshiki

358.overview: Luffy attempts to attack Gecko Moria, but instead is forced to face his shadow clone: Doppelman, while Usopp continues to maneuver around the Wild Zombies to get to Perona only to now face Bearsy's wrath. Sanji saves Nami from Absalom, who doesn't see him as a threat due to the power of his zombie, but Sanji unleashes his own rage against the lion-faced man, both for harming the women of the crew as well as an unknown connection between the two of them.
358.summary:
Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami`s beastly abductor!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: スケスケの因縁? 奪われたサンジの夢
title.en: A Clear-Clear History? Sanji`s Stolen Dream
title.fr: Le lien de l`invisibilité ? Le rêve volé de Sanji !
title.es: ¿Una conexión invisible? El sueño robado de Sanji
title.ru: Связь с фруктом Сукэ-Сукэ. Отнятая мечта Санджи
title.ar: تاريخ فاكهة الشّفافية؟ حُلم سانجي المسروق
title.x-jat: Suke Suke no Innen? Ubawareta Sanji no Yume

359.overview: It looked like the end for Sanji as Absalom used his devil fruit ability, but Sanji comes back with his anger and starts beating Absalom to death, after revealing he always desired the See-through See-through Fruit the devil fruit which allowed Absalom to turn invisible. Meanwhile Luffy is still having trouble with Gecko Moria's Shadow the Doppleman who uses him to turn into bats, Luffy finally finds a way to attack Moria by using Gum Gum Stamp! The Hollow Hollow fruit user, Perona, is still being chased by Usopp who in turn is being chased by Bearsy, but Perona gets away. Usopp stops Bearsy and catches up to Perona who is floating in mid air out the window, she then calls herself the "Ghost Princess".
359.summary:
Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 助けて英雄[ヒーロー]!? 敵は不死身のプリンセス
title.en: Save Me, Hero!! My Enemy Is the Immortal Princess!
title.fr: Un héros à la rescousse ! L`ennemi est une princesse immortelle
title.es: ¡Héroe al rescate! El oponente es la princesa invencible
title.ru: Спаси меня, о герой!! Противник – неуязвимая принцесса
title.ar: أنقذني أيّها البطل!! عدوّي هي الأميرة الخالدة
title.x-jat: Tasukete Hero!? Teki wa Fujimi no Princess

360.overview: Usopp is forced to go through a gauntlet of Perona's Horo-Horo powers, including an untouchable body, size manipulation, passing right through him and creating mini-Hollows that slowly rip away at his stamina and body. Temporarily turning into Sogeking to finally remove Bearsy's shadow, Usopp is forced up against a desperate wall until he finally discovers Perona's weakness: her own room, where her real body lies helplessly while using her abilities!
360.summary:
After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ペローナ恐怖!? 嘘のウはウソップのウ
title.en: Perona Is Terrified!! Usopp and Untruthful Share the Same `U`!
title.fr: La bête noire de Perona ! L’usurpateur signe d’un U, qui veut dire Usopp
title.it: Usopp e la strategia della menzogna
title.es: ¡Perona aterrada! La “U” de “Uso” es la “U” de “Usopp”
title.ru: Перона в ужасе! Усопп – мастер лжи
title.ar: بيرونا مذعورة!! `ب` الّتي في أوسوبّ هي `ب` الّتي في كذب
title.x-jat: Perona Kyoufu!? Uso no U wa Usopp no U

361.overview: The battle between Usopp and Perona continues; Usopp fires something at Perona's real body which seems to miss it, giving Perona the confidence to fight back again. This time she produces a huge hollow, at least four times the size of Usopp, which grabs Usopp in its mouth and won't let go, leaving Perona time to go and return to her body. She detonates it, but the explosion gets sucked into the impact Dial, which Usopp cleverly brought out. He uses this on a Zombie-Hippo which was sneaking up, breaking his arm, but he then reveals that he stuck Perona's arm to the wall; he wins the battle by firing hundreds of little moving fake cockroaches onto her, and then smacking her over the head with an inflatable ten-ton hammer.
361.summary:
Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can`t lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 屋根に舞う斬撃!! 決着ゾロVSリューマ
title.en: Slashes Dancing on the Rooftop!! Showdown: Zoro vs. Ryuma!
title.fr: Les sabres virevoltent sur le toit ! Zoro contre Ryuma : épilogue
title.es: ¡Cortes que danzan sobre la azotea! Finaliza el Zoro contra Ryuuma
title.ru: Танец клинков на крыше!! Окончание битвы: Зоро против Рюма
title.ar: ضربات سيف ترقص على السّقف!! نزال زورو ضدّ ريوما!
title.x-jat: Yane ni Mau Zangeki!! Kecchaku Zoro Tai Ryuuma

362.overview: Zoro duels Ryuma in Hogback's lab, while Franky guards over the injured Brook. Neither Zoro, nor Ryuma, can gain any advantage over the other, as they keep matching the other's attack. Their attacks quickly destroy the lab, forcing them to escape the room and continue their fierce duel on the roof. As Brook watches on, he comes the conclusion that Ryuma was never taking their fights seriously. After an intense sword fight, during which the entire roof collapses to the ground below, Zoro finally defeats Ryuma using a technique which sets him ablaze. Zoro lands hard on the lip of the roof below. Ryuma manages to land on a higher ledge. Ryuma staggers slightly, then acknowledges his defeat at Zoro's hands. Sheathing Shunsui, Ryuma throws it to Zoro. Ryuma collapses in a bout of flames and Brook's shadow is finally returned to him, to his great joy. Zoro acknowledges Ryuma's skill as a swordsman and says he wishes he could have met Ryuuma before he died. He also agrees to forget the outcome of their fight.
362.summary:
While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: チョッパー激怒!! ホグバック魔の医術
title.en: Chopper Is Furious!! Hogback`s Evil Medical Practices!
title.fr: Chopper en colère ! La médecine diabolique du docteur Hogback !
title.es: ¡La ira de Chopper! Las demoníacas prácticas médicas de Hogback
title.ru: Чоппер в ярости!! Бесчеловечные эксперименты Хогбака
title.ar: تشوبّر غاضب!! ممارسات هوغباك الطّبّيّة الشّرّيرة
title.x-jat: Chopper Gekido!! Hogback Ma no Ijutsu

363.overview: Chopper and Robin are outmatched by Zoro and Sanji's zombies, both of whom have almost completely lost the personalities they acquired from their shadows. Chopper tells Hogback that he had once respected him, but does not anymore after realizing the true nature of Hogbacks experiments. Hogback, however, argues that the zombies are truly alive, and recalls that he had fallen in love with Cindry while she was alive, only to have her reject him in favor of her fiancé. After her death, Hogback agreed to serve Moria in exchange for reviving her. Chopper becomes furious and attempts to attack and purify Cindry, but Cindry's strength, and Zoro and Sanji's zombies prevent them from doing so. Zoro's zombie and Sanji's zombie begin fighting each other, still unable to get along, and Robin tricks Hogback into telling them to jump out of the tower. Hogback orders Cindry to attack, but Cindry, having temporarily regained her original self, is unable to move. Elsewhere, Luffy is still unable to hit Moria, and Oars arrives at their location.
363.summary:
Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback`s evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who`s wearing his shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: オーズ吼える!! 出て来い麦わらの一味
title.en: Oars Roars! Come Out, Straw Hat Crew!
title.fr: Le rugissement d’Oz ! Montrez-vous, pirates au chapeau de paille !
title.es: ¡Oz ruge! Da la cara, banda de Sombrero de Paja
title.ru: Рёв Оза!! Выходи, команда Соломенной шляпы
title.ar: أورز يزأر!! اخرج يا طاقم قبّعة القشّ
title.x-jat: Oz Hoeru!! Detekoi Mugiwara no Ichimi

364.overview: Oars appears declaring his submission to Moria. Moria instructs him to hunt down the Straw hat pirates. Oars attacks Luffy. Luffy escapes and starts chasing Moria who flees the scene. Hogback without Cindry's support tries to run away. Chopper catches him and is helped by Robin against him. The fight is interrupted by Oars' attack smashing through the ceiling. Sanji, distracted by all this, lets his guard down letting Absalom take Nami away. Everyone runs out of the mansion and Oars calls out for the Straw hat crew to come forth and face him.
364.summary:
Moria`s mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy`s shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji`s eyes!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 敵はルフィ!! 最強ゾンビ対麦わらの一味
title.en: Luffy Is the Enemy! The Ultimate Zombie vs. the Straw Hat Crew!
title.fr: Luffy est notre ennemi ! Le plus puissant des zombies contre les pirates !
title.es: ¡El enemigo es Luffy! El zombie más peligroso contra la banda de Sombrero de Paja
title.ru: Враг – Луффи!! Сильнейший зомби против команды Соломенной шляпы
title.ar: لوفي هو العدوّ!! الزّومبي الأقوى ضدّ طاقم قبّعة القشّ
title.x-jat: Teki wa Luffy!! Saikyou Zombie Tai Mugiwara no Ichimi

365.overview: Oars begins fighting Sanji, Zoro, Franky, Brook, Robin, Usopp and Chopper, having inherited Luffy's fighting style but lost his memories. The crew tries to fight against him, but learns that he is incredibly strong and fast, even if he is unable to stretch like Luffy can. Oars manages to apparently knock out all seven of his opponents. Elsewhere, Absalom attempts to resume his wedding to Nami, and Luffy continues pursuing Moria, as the chase leads him into the forest.
365.summary:
One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy`s got his sights set on Moria, but he`d better hurry if he wants to save his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 倒れろアブサロム!! ナミ友情の雷撃!!
title.en: You`re Going Down, Absalom!! Nami`s Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
title.fr: Vaincre Absalom par amitié ! Le coup de foudre de Nami !
title.es: ¡Absalom derrotado! ¡El relámpago de la amistad de Nami!
title.ru: Абсалом в нокауте!! Нами, дружба и разряд молнии!!
title.ar: ستُهزم يا أبسالوم!! هجوم صداقة نامي البارق!!
title.x-jat: Taorero Absalom!! Nami Yuujou no Raigeki!!

366.overview: Perona finally wakes up and is brought up to date with the current events on Thriller Bark. She decides to run away. Nami also wakes up to see that she is in a wedding ceremony with Absalom. Lola interrupts the wedding giving Nami a chance to escape. Absalom brings Lola down. Nami takes revenge by beating Absalom. Luffy continues chasing Moria and Oars who is looking for the rest of the Straw hats. But everyone who he thought he had defeated is back up on their feet ready for a second round.
366.summary:
Nami wakes up just in time to find out she’s about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by a very jealous warthog!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 奪えダウン!! 必殺麦わらドッキング?
title.en: Knock Him Down!! Special Attack: Straw Hat Docking?
title.fr: Et de un à terre ! Une technique secrète : l’arrimage des chapeaux de paille
title.es: ¡Consigamos un Down! Muerte segura: ¿Docking de los Sombrero de Paja?
title.ru: Нокдаун!! Убийственное объединение пиратов Соломенной шляпы
title.ar: لنطح به!! الهجوم القاتل: اندماج طاقم قبّعة القشّ؟
title.x-jat: Ubae Down!! Hissatsu Mugiwara Docking?

367.overview: The Straw Hats attempt a "docking" maneuver by hanging onto Franky in order to form a "Giant Robot Warrior", but it fails when Robin refuses to participate, as she considers it too embarrassing. The Straw Hats combine their strengths to get Oars off-balance and cause him to fall to the ground, enraging him. Brook is absent from the battle, as he leaves to find milk to drink to heal his wounds. Elsewhere, Nami attempts to find the treasure of Thriller Bark, but discovers that it is empty. Perona's subordinates load the treasure and food onto the Thousand Sunny when they see the Shichibukai Bartholomew Kuma aboard, looking for Moria.
367.summary:
Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 足音なき襲来!! 謎の訪問者 暴君くま
title.en: The Silent Assault!! The Mysterious Visitor, `Tyrant` Kuma!
title.fr: Une invasion silencieuse. Le mystérieux visiteur : Kuma le tyran
title.es: ¡Una invasión silenciosa! El misterioso visitante: Kuma el Tirano
title.ru: Беззвучное вторжение!! Загадочный посетитель: Тиран Кума
title.ar: الهجوم الصّامت!! الزّائر الغامض، كوما الطّاغية
title.x-jat: Ashioto Naki Shuurai!! Nazo no Boumonsha: Boukun Kuma

368.overview: Taking advantage of several weaknesses, including his stupidity and similarities to Luffy, the Straw Hats continue to wear away at Oars, yet his continued persistence allows Zoro to test his new sword Shuusui for battle. Meanwhile, Kuma tries to find out Moria's location from Perona, yet her defiance forces him to make her disappear with an ungloved hand before speaking with Nami about his "choice to be here". Luffy appears to catch Moria again, only to discover it is Doppelman.
368.summary:
Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: オーズ+モリア 力と頭脳の最凶合体
title.en: Oars + Moria! The Most Heinous Combination of Brains and Brawn!
title.fr: Oz plus Moria : Force et intelligence, le pire des mélanges !
title.es: Oz + Moria: La combinación más fuerte de cerebro y fuerza física
title.ru: Оз и Мория – невероятная комбинация силы и интеллекта
title.ar: نهاية المعركة وشيكة! وجّه الضربة القاضية!
title.x-jat: Oars Plus Moriah: Chikara to Zunou no Saikyou Gattai

369.overview: Moria's shadow escapes, leaving Luffy stranded in the forest, as some strange people reveal that they are looking for him. Zoro begins the fight against Oars, revealing the new 108 Caliber Phoenix with his newly-obtained sword, but Oars manages to avoid his attacks. Kuma informs Moria of the appointment of Blackbeard as Crocodile's replacement, and warns him that the Straw Hat pirates may defeat him, too. Moria refuses Kuma's offer to help him, and enters Oars' stomach to guide him against the crew. The crew realize that as Luffy failed to catch and defeat Moria, it is up to them to defeat Moria and Oars before dawn. Usopp runs to the kitchen to gather more salt to purify Oars, but Oars strikes out at him, destroying the passage to the kitchen. Brook, his injuries healed, manages to save Usopp and bring the Straw Hats a large bag of salt.
369.summary:
Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 逆転への秘策 ナイトメア・ルフィ見参
title.en: The Secret Plan to Turn the Tables! Nightmare Luffy Makes His Appearance!
title.fr: Un plan secret pour tout renverser ! L’apparition de Nightmare Luffy !
title.es: Un giro con la estrategia secreta y la aparición de Nighmare Luffy
title.ru: Безумная стратегия перевоплощения. Появление Кошмарного Луффи
title.ar: الخطّة السريّة لقلب الطاولة! ظهور الكابوس لوفي!
title.x-jat: Gyakuten e no Hisaku: Nightmare Luffy Kenzan

370.overview: With Moria's guidance, Oars is better able to counter the Straw Hats' strategies and turn their attacks against them. Franky is knocked unconscious after a failed attempt to fire himself at Oars with a giant slingshot known as Kuwagata and shoot him at point-blank range with Weapons Left. Nami arrives and joins the battle, but Oars demonstrates that he can somehow stretch his limbs, which the crew realizes is Moria's doing. Elsewhere, Luffy meets up with the Rolling Pirates, whose shadows have been stolen by Moria. They plant shadows into him in order to multiply his fighting strength and grant him new skills so that he can defeat Moria.
370.summary:
Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 壊滅, 麦わら一味 カゲカゲの能力[ちから]全開
title.en: The Straw Hat Crew Gets Wiped Out! The Shadow-Shadow`s Powers in Full Swing!
title.fr: L’équipage au chapeau de paille est anéanti. Le plein potentiel du fruit de l’ombre
title.es: ¡La banda de Sombrero de Paja aniquilada! La habilidad Kage Kage al completo
title.ru: Команда Соломенной шляпы уничтожена – высшая сила фрукта Каге-каге
title.ar: طاقم قبعة القش يُباد! قوى فاكهة الظل تطلق عنانها!
title.x-jat: Kaimetsu, Mugiwara Ichimi: Kagekage no Chikara Zenkai

371.overview: Moria explains that he enabled Oars to stretch by stretching his shadow, thereby forcing his body to stretch along with it in order to ensure that the body and shadow are the same shape. Usopp fires Brook out of Kuwagata, with Robin making him spin and Nami electrifying him, but he only does minor damage to Oars and is knocked out when Oars retaliates. Robin attempts to use her powers on Moria, but he attacks her with his shadow and then switches places with it, rendering her attack useless. He then takes her shadow, rendering her unconscious. Chopper discovered that Oars died of frostbite, and that while he does not feel any pain, he can still take damage from their attacks. Sanji and Chopper launch a combo attack on Oars, who then knocks out both of them with Gum Gum Gatling, leaving only Nami, Zoro and Usopp standing.
371.summary:
Brook joins the fight as the Straw Hats valiantly try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy returns. Unfortunately, even their combined powers are no match for these evil enemies!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 超絶バトルスタート! ルフィVSルフィ
title.en: The Incredible Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Luffy!
title.fr: La bataille ultime commence ! Luffy contre Luffy
title.es: ¡Comienza la batalla por la superioridad! Luffy contra Luffy
title.ru: Великое сражение начинается! Луффи против Луффи
title.ar: بداية المعركة المذهلة! لوفي ضدّ لوفي!
title.x-jat: Chouzetsu Battle Start! Luffy vs Luffy

372.overview: Zoro tries attacking Oars' arm again, but Oars knocks him out by kneeing him into a wall. Usopp shoots Brook's salt into Oars' mouth with Kuwagata, but Moria's shadow catches it and throws it out, breaking the bag and preventing them from using it again. Oars tries to stomp Usopp and Nami, but Nightmare Luffy arrives and gets them to safety in an instant. While the Rolling Pirates take the unconscious Straw Hats to safety, Luffy begins attacking Oars, and with his shadows, is far stronger than his opponent. Moria attempts to escape, but Luffy punches him out with Gum Gum Pistol and sends Oars flying with Gum Gum Storm. The shadows leave Luffy's body, but he appears to have won.
372.summary:
Oars and Moria ruthlessly pummel the badly beaten Straw Hats. The situation looks bleak until the shocking arrival of Nightmare Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 決着迫る! たたき込め, とどめの一撃
title.en: The End of the Battle Is Nigh! Pound in the Finishing Move!
title.fr: Le dénouement est proche ! Un coup de grâce à donner
title.es: ¡La conclusión se acerca! Propiciando el golpe final
title.ru: Развязка близка! Нанесём последний удар
title.ar: نهاية المعركة وشيكة! وجّه الضربة القاضية!
title.x-jat: Kecchaku Semaru! Tatakikome, Todome no Ichigeki

373.overview: Oars recovers from Nightmare Luffy's attack. However, the Strawhats all get back on their feet, from Luffy to Brook, and launch a final devastating attack on Oars, which ends with Luffy smashing a Gigant Bazooka into Oars' face from above, breaking his spine and finally defeating the demon. Moria, however, gets out of Oars' stomach moments later, and prepares himself for his ultimate technique, Shadows Asgard. By sucking up all of the shadows of all of the zombies on Thriller Bark, totaling one thousand shadows, Moria becomes a grotesque monster, as big as Oars in size with short spindly legs, gigantic arms, and a huge bloated neck pulsating with veins.
373.summary:
After Luffy’s shadow power disappears, he’ll need help from rest of the Straw Hats to land a devastating finishing blow in his battle against Oars.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 肉体が消える! 悪夢の島に射す朝日!
title.en: Our Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Shines on the Nightmarish Island!
title.fr: Les corps se désintègrent ! Le soleil darde ses premiers rayons sur l’île des cauchemars !
title.es: ¡Los cuerpos se desvanecen! ¡El Sol de la mañana ilumina la isla de las pesadillas!
title.ru: Исчезающие тела. Утренние лучи солнца над островом кошмаров
title.ar: أجسادنا تختفي! تسطع شمس الصباح على الجزيرة الشيطانيّة!
title.x-jat: Karada ga Kieru! Akumu no Shima ni Sasu Asahi!

374.overview: Luffy begins fighting Moria, entering Gear Second in the process, but the blows that he deals to Moria are not enough to force him to release the shadows. Moria attacks Luffy with a devastating blow, but he manages to continue fighting, and activates Gear Third while Gear Second is still active. With a new technique, Gum Gum Gigant Jet Shell, he knocks Moria under the collapsing mast of Thriller Bark and forces him to release all his shadows just as dawn arrives. However, the ones who had their shadows stolen start to vanish.
374.summary:
Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for a final showdown with Luffy. Can the Straw Hats save the day before the dawn reduces them all to ashes!?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 終わらない危機! 麦わら一味抹殺指令
title.en: Not Out of Danger Yet! Orders to Annihilate the Straw Hat Crew!
title.fr: Les crises s’enchaînent ! Ordre d’extermination des pirates au chapeau de paille !
title.es: ¡Crisis sin fin! Orden de eliminar a la banda de Sombrero de Paja
title.ru: Приказ об уничтожении команды Соломенной шляпы
title.ar: لم ينته الخطر بعد! أوامر بإبادة طاقم قبعة القش!
title.x-jat: Owaranai Kiki! Mugiwara Ichimi Massatsu Shirei

375.overview: All of Moria's victims recover their shadow and celebrate regaining their ability to enter daylight. Luffy, Zoro, Sanji and Robin recover their shadows in time to avoid being disintegrated. Luffy lies unconscious from his wounds and using Gear Second against Moria, and Usopp worries about him endangering himself by having to use the technique on the stronger enemies ahead. Kuma receives orders from the World Government to kill everyone on Thriller Bark in order to cover up Moria's defeat. He attacks the survivors with a strange move that sends several people flying backwards, before turning his attention to Zoro.
375.summary:
The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches its epic end, and the gargantuan shadow of the towering brute known as Kuma causes a panic on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: すべてを弾く くまのニキュニキュの能力[ちから]
title.en: It Repels Everything! Kuma`s Paw-Paw Power!
title.fr: Le pouvoir des coussinets : Kuma peut tout repousser
title.it: Gli incredibili poteri del frutto Pad Pad
title.es: El poder de repelerlo todo, el poder Nikyu Nikyu de Kuma
title.ru: Способности плода Никю-Никю. Полное отражение всего
title.ar: تصدّ كلّ شيء! قوّة كفّ كوما!
title.x-jat: Subete o Hajiku: Kuma no Nikyunikyu no Chikara

376.overview: Zoro attacks Kuma, who reveals that he has eaten the Paw-pad Paw-pad fruit, and shows his ability to repel attacks, move considerable distances almost instantly and repel the air to attack his opponents. Zoro is quickly outmatched, and Sanji and Usopp's attempts to help him are rendered futile by Kuma's hard body and ability to block projectiles. Kuma then offers to spare the survivors of Thriller Bark if they turn over Luffy, but they unanimously refuse. He then detonates a paw print full of compressed air, devastating the island.
376.summary:
Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 仲間の痛みは我が痛み ゾロ決死の戦い
title.en: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro`s Desperate Fight!
title.fr: La douleur de mon ami sera mienne. Zoro se prépare au pire
title.es: El dolor de mis compañeros es mi dolor. Zoro lucha praparado para morir
title.ru: Боль моих накама – моя боль. Смертельная битва Зоро
title.ar: ألم أصدقائي هو ألمي! قتال زورو اليائس!
title.x-jat: Nakama no Itami wa Waga Itami: Zoro Kesshi no Tatakai

377.overview: While almost everyone on the island is knocked out in the blast, Zoro slashes Kuma with Shishi Sonson, but sees that it is ineffective, as Kuma is a Pacifista, a cyborg whose body is harder than steel. Seeing that he can no longer fight, Zoro offers his life to save Luffy, saying that he cannot hope to become the world's best swordsman if he cannot protect his captain. Sanji attempts to take Zoro's place, but Zoro knocks him out. As part of his agreement with Kuma, Zoro takes in all of Luffy's pain and fatigue, which Kuma says would kill him if he suffered it on top of his already severe wounds. Zoro takes in the pain, and Kuma leaves, remarking on how Luffy has a loyal crew. Luffy regains consciousness, surprisingly energetic, while Zoro emerges from his sacrifice near death.
377.summary:
Zoro slashes against the Pacifista Kuma is meet with resistance harder than steel.  Unable to win with his swords he bets everything on a trade.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 遠い日の約束 海賊の唄と小さなクジラ
title.en: A Promise from a Distant Day! The Pirates` Song and a Small Whale!
title.fr: Une promesse très lointaine. La chanson des pirates et la petite baleine
title.es: La promesa de aquel lejano día. La canción de los piratas y la pequeña ballena
title.ru: Обещание из далёкого прошлого – китёнок и пиратская песня
title.ar: وعدٌ من يوم بعيد! أغنيّة القراصنة والحوت الصّغير!
title.x-jat: Tooi Hi no Yakusoku: Kaizoku no Uta to Chiisana Kujira

378.overview: Hogback and Absalom escape Thriller Bark with the unconscious Moria, and reveal that Blackbeard gained his status as a Shichibukai by defeating Ace. The next day, the Straw Hats celebrate their victory over Moria, but do not know why Zoro is so badly wounded. Sanji hears the story from the Risky Brothers, but prevents them from telling anyone else, saying it would trouble Luffy greatly to hear that Zoro suffered for his sake, but Robin eavesdrops on the conversation. Luffy tells Brook that Laboon is alive, and he is overjoyed to hear it, and begins to think about the time 50 years ago when he and his pirate crew first met Laboon.
378.summary:
As the story of Kuma and Zoro is discussed, Brooks remembers back to when he was alive.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ブルックの過去 陽気な仲間悲しき別れ
title.en: Brook`s Past! A Sad Farewell with His Cheerful Comrade!
title.fr: Le passé de Brook. Tristes adieux à de joyeux compagnons
title.es: El pasado de Brook. Triste adiós a la alegre banda
title.ru: Прошлое Брука – грустное прощание с весёлой командой
title.ar: ماضي بروكّ! وداع محزن مع صديقه البهيج!
title.x-jat: Brook no Kako: Youki na Nakama Kanashiki Wakare

379.overview: Brook recalls his past, when the whale Laboon started following his pirate ship and befriended the crew. When the crew headed toward the Grand Line, they had no choice but to leave Laboon behind because the danger the sea would present to a young whale like him, but Laboon followed them over Reverse Mountain, anyway. Brook and his captain convince Laboon to stay behind, promising that after they traveled through the entire Grand Line and he grew strong enough to follow them, they would come back and bring him on their adventures. They were unable to fulfill the promise, though.
379.summary:
The continued story of Brooks the pirate and his friend Laboon.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ビンクスの酒 過去と現在をつなぐ唄
title.en: Bink`s Booze! The Song That Connects the Past with the Present!
title.fr: Le bon rhum de Binks. Une chanson qui relie le passé au présent
title.it: Tra il presente e il passato
title.es: El sake de Binks ¡La canción que conecta el pasado con el presente!
title.ru: Cаке Бинкса – песня, соединяющая прошлое и настоящее
title.ar: ساكي بينكس! الأغنيّة الّتي تصل الماضي بالحاضر!
title.x-jat: Binks no Sake: Kako to Genzai o Tsunagu Uta

380.overview: Brook recalls the Rumbar Pirates' journey through the Grand Line, where they faced many dangers but still managed to enjoy themselves. The captain contracted an illness and attempted to leave the Grand Line through the Calm Belt with the other infected crew, leaving Brook in charge of the remaining pirates. The journey continued until some powerful enemies defeated the Rumbar Pirates in the Florian Triangle, fatally poisoning them. As they were dying, they sang Binks's Booze one last time, recording it in a Tone Dial in the hopes that Brook would revive with his Devil Fruit power and deliver the shell to Laboon. Back in the present, Brook silently hopes Laboon will wait just a little longer for his return.
380.summary:
Brooks shares the story of the final days of the Rumbar pirates and their final song.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 新たな仲間! 音楽家・鼻唄のブルック
title.en: A New Crewmate! The Musician, Humming Brook!
title.fr: Un nouveau compagnon ! Brook, musicien et fredonneur
title.es: ¡Un nuevo compañero! ¡El músico Brook el Susurrante!
title.ru: Новый накама! Музыкант – Напевающий Брук
title.ar: رفيق جديد! الموسيقار المهمهم بروكّ!
title.x-jat: Arata na Nakama! Ongakuka Hanauta no Brook

381.overview: Brook tells Luffy that he is glad to be alive and asks if he can join the crew, which Luffy approves of. All the Straw Hats are shocked by this, except for Zoro, who is sleeping, and Robin, who knew Luffy would accept him no matter what, but they nevertheless welcome him to the crew. Two days later, Usopp and Franky make a grave for the dead Rumbar Pirates, and Zoro lays the broken Yubashiri at the grave. Nami gets a Vivre Card from Lola, which points the way to Lola's mother, a pirate in the New World. Luffy takes out the piece of paper he received from Ace, which is also a Vivre Card, and learns that as it is burning and shrinking, Ace's life is in danger. Believing that Ace can get out of trouble on his own, Luffy decides to head onward rather than go to rescue him, and the Straw Hats sail away from Thriller Bark. As the Luffy and his crew sail away, three enormous and mysterious figure appears in the fog, looking over Thriller Bark.
381.summary:
With a new official crewmate, the Straw Hat Pirates are ready to set sail.  Lola shares with Nami a unique item only available in the New World!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ノロノロの脅威 銀狐のフォクシー再び
title.en: The Slow-Slow Menace! `Silver Fox` Foxy Returns!
title.fr: La menace ramollo ! Le retour de Foxy le Renard Argenté !
title.es: La amenaza Noro Noro. El regreso de Foxy el Zorro Plateado
title.ru: Луч Норо-Норо – Возвращение Фокси
title.ar: خطر فاكهة التّباطؤ! عودة الثّعلب الفضّيّ فوكسي!
title.x-jat: Noronoro no Kyoui: Gingitsune no Foxy Futatabi
title.uk: Норо-Норо загроза. Срібний лис Фоксі повернувся

382.overview: The Straw Hats take a vacation at Spa Island, but while there, encounter Foxy and his crew, who are pursuing two small girls: Lina and her older sister Sayo. The Straw Hats manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates, and learn that they had been pursuing Lina and Sayo for the girls' notebook, which shows their father's research on how to create a special gem, the solution for which can be found on the island. Lina considers her father a liar, but Sayo believes him. Suddenly, Sayo is abducted, and the owner of the island, Doran, says that if they want her back, they must complete the research and find the gem.
382.summary:
While resting at a floating resort, Spa Island. The Straw Hat crew runs into a familiar old face and big trouble.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: お宝大争奪戦! 崩壊! スパアイランド号
title.en: The Great Scramble for Treasure! Collapse! Spa Island!
title.fr: La grande chasse au trésor ! Spa Island est anéantie !
title.es: ¡La gran competición del tesoro! ¡Derrumbamiento! El Spa land
title.ru: Борьба за Великое сокровище! Крах острова Спа!
title.ar: التّزاحم الكبير من أجل الكنز! انهاري! جزيرة المنتجع!
title.x-jat: Otakara Daisoudatsusen! Houkai! Spa Island Gou
title.uk: Велика гонитва за скарбами! Обвал острову Спа!

383.overview: After Lina reveals that she has searched all over the ship, Luffy decides to destroy the ship in order to find Sayo. The Straw Hats manage to fight off Doran's men, but Doran unveils a large cannon and aims it at Sayo. Sayo tells Lina that their father truly cared for them and believed that his research would bear fruit, and left in order to protect them from his pursuers. The Straw Hats manage to rescue Sayo and destroy Spa Island, and notice that the X on Lina's father's map pointed to an X-shaped underwater volcano opening beneath the island. Several days later, Sayo and Lina complete the gem and send it to the Straw Hats, but as candy rain falls on the Sunny, Luffy accidentally loses it.
383.summary:
After Sayo is kidnapped, Luffy agrees to help Rina get her back.  His foolproof idea sends shockwaves through Spa Island.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ブルック大奮闘 真の仲間への道険し?
title.en: Brook`s Great Struggle! Is the Path to Becoming a True Comrade Rigorous?
title.fr: Brook tombe sur un os. Le difficile chemin pour devenir un véritable ami !
title.es: La dura lucha de Brook. ¿El difícil camino para hacerse un verdadero Sombrero de Paja?
title.ru: Мучения Брука – трудности на пути становления Накама!
title.ar: كفاح بروكّ العظيم! هل الطّريق لتصبح رفيقًا حقيقيًّا وعر؟
title.x-jat: Brook Daifuntou: Shin no Nakama e no Michi Kewashi?
title.uk: Велика боротьба Брука. Чи важко стати справжнім накама?

384.overview: After reading an account of the various adventures that the Straw Hats have had, Brook resolves to be as much use as he can to prove his worth, but his well-intentioned efforts only manage to annoy or get in the way of the others. Brook then reveals his insecurites to Robin, saying that he'll leave the crew if he proves to be only a burden. Robin tells him that she used to feel similarly, until the Straw Hats came to save her at Enies Lobby, and she had finally found her place. Encouraged, Brook later reflects on how he has found his place after decades of being alone, and resolves to do his best so that he can have stories to tell of his own.
384.summary:
Brook’s eagerness to become a trust comrade is backfiring immensely. What is causing his new anxiety and the crew survive much longer?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 偉大なる航路半周到達! 赤い土の大陸
title.en: Halfway Across the Grand Line! Arrival at the Red Line!
title.fr: À la moitié de Grand Line ! Red Line nous tend les bras !
title.es: ¡Llegando a la mitad de la Grand Line! La Red Line
title.ru: Прибытие на середину Гранд Лайн! Ред Лайн
title.ar: في منتصف الغراند لاين، الوصول إلى الرّيد لاين!
title.x-jat: Grand Line Hanshuu Toutatsu! Red Line
title.uk: Половина шляху на Ґранд Лайн! Прибуття на Ред Лайн

385.overview: After traversing the treacherous Serpent Currents, the Straw Hats finally arrive at the Red Line, signifying that they've sailed halfway around the world and that their voyage is half over. While the crew reflects and takes a well-deserved rest, a sea monster attacks. Luffy easily dispatches it, forcing it to spit up a talking starfish and a genuine Mermaid onto the Sunny's deck.
385.summary:
The Straw Hats have finally reached the red line with each member thinking back on the adventure.  Straws are picked to decided who will take the submarine to investigate the way to Fish-man Isle.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 麦わら一味憎し 鉄仮面のデュバル登場
title.en: Hatred for the Straw Hats! Iron Mask Duval Appears!
title.fr: Une dent contre les chapeaux de paille ! Duval, l’homme au masque de fer, fait son entrée !
title.es: El que odia a la tripulación de los Sombrero de Paja. Entra Duval máscara de hierro
title.ru: Ненавистник команды Соломенной шляпы – Дюваль «Железная маска»!
title.ar: كراهية تُجاه طاقم قبّعة القشّ، ظهور دوفال ذو القناع الحديديّ
title.x-jat: Mugiwara Ichimi Nikushi: Tekkamen no Duval Toujou
title.uk: Ненависть до мугівар. Поява Залізної маски Дюваля

386.overview: The Mermaid and starfish, named Keimi and Paggag, respectively, thank the Straw Hats for helping them, and Keimi offers to give them some Takoyaki (fried octopus), after she meets up with her friend Hacchin as thanks. However, a call from him reveals that he has been kidnapped by the Fishman Macro Gang as bait for her. Luffy decides to rescue him for the Takoyaki, and the crew sets sail for their hideout. En route, they're briefly attacked by the Flying Fish Riders, a gang of ruffians aiding the Macro Gang, who are commanded by a masked man named Duval.
386.summary:
After indirectly rescuing a unique pair, they beg the straw heats to help rescue a friend that has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 因縁の再会! 囚われの魚人を救い出せ
title.en: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fishman!
title.fr: Des retrouvailles sous le signe du destin ! Il faut sauver l’Homme-poisson prisonnier
title.es: ¡La reunión predestinada! Salva al tritón encarcelado
title.ru: И снова их свела судьба! Спасти схваченного рыбочеловека!
title.ar: اللّقاء الموعود! إنقاذ البرمائيّ المسجون!
title.x-jat: Innen no Saikai! Toraware no Gyojin o Sukuidase
title.uk: Доленосна зустріч! Врятувати увʼязнену риболюдину

387.overview: Duval bears a grudge against one of the Straw Hats, but it is not known which one. When the Straw Hats reach the hideout, they discover that Hacchin is none other than the octopus Fishman Hatchan, formerly of Arlong's crew. Although reluctant to save him with this new knowledge, Keimi convinces the crew to go through with it. However, everything was a trap set by Duval, and the Straw Hats are ambushed by the Flying Fish Riders.
387.summary:
Arriving at Duval’s base, it is obvious a trap, but when Camie’s friend is recognized as Hatchan, a former Arlong Pirate.  Luffy refuses to help so Camie and Pappgu attempt the rescue by themselves.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 悲劇! 仮面に隠されたデュバルの真実
title.en: Tragedy! The Truth Hidden Behind Duval`s Mask!
title.fr: Tragédie ! La vérité cachée derrière le masque de Duval
title.es: ¡Tragedia! La verdad de Duval desenmascarada
title.ru: Трагедия! Вся правда Дюваля в железной маске!
title.ar: مأساة! الحقيقة المخفيّة خلف قناع دوفال!
title.x-jat: Higeki! Kamen ni Kakusareta Duval no Shinjitsu
title.uk: Трагедія! Правда за маскою Дюваля

388.overview: While the battle between the Straw Hats and the Flying Fish Riders rages on, Zoro frees Hatchan from his cage, and the Fishman in turn saves him from an attack, revealing that he feels bad about their battle at Arlong Park. Meanwhile, Luffy crashes into Duval's hut and catches a glimpse of his unmasked face before being chased back outside. Once outside, Duval reveals that Sanji is the Straw Hat he wants to kill. After Luffy knocks his helmet off, the reason for his hatred is laid bare: Marines and bounty hunters have been relentlessly pursuing him because he looks exactly like the poorly-drawn visage on Sanji's wanted poster!
388.summary:
The flying fish riders attack on the Straw Hats take place in the air and sea. Luffy is memorized by the flying fish as Zoro attempts to free Hatchan.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 炸裂! サニー号の超秘密兵器ガオン砲
title.en: Unleash the Sunny`s Super Secret Weapon, the Gaon Cannon!
title.fr: Une grosse explosion ! La super arme secrète du Sunny : Le Graou Canon !
title.es: ¡Explota! La nueva arma del Sunny-Go el Cañón Gaon
title.ru: Взрыв! Сверхсекретное орудие Санни-Го – Пушка Гаон!
title.ar: انفجار! مدفع الغاون، سلاح ساني فائقّ السّرّيّة!
title.x-jat: Sakuretsu! Sunny Gou no Chou Himitsu Heiki Gaon-hou
title.uk: Вибух! Супер секретна зброя Санні: гармата Ґаон

389.overview: After the surprising reveal, Duval tells his story of living a peaceful life as a mafioso until Marines and bounty hunters came after him for Sanji's bounty, mistaking him for the Straw Hat, casing him to flee and wear a helmet to hide his face. The Flying Fish Riders attempt to drown Sanji by dragging him underwater, but the cook is saved by the intervention of Keimi. Duval then tries to sink the Thousand Sunny by having his men drop a giant anchor on it, but Franky reveals the Chicken Voyage reverse function to dodge it, and then the Gaon Cannon to wipe out most of the Riders. Enraged, Duval orders his pet bison Motobaro to gore Luffy, but Luffy stops the beast by unknowingly using haki, the beast goes wild and then faints, much to everyone's surprise. Sick of everything, Sanji takes things into his own hands, and sends Duval flying into his hut with a faceful of kicks.
389.summary:
The secret of Duval is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 魚人島を目指して上陸 シャボンディ諸島
title.en: Landing on the Way to Fishman Island! The Sabaody Archipelago!
title.fr: Objectif : l`île des hommes-poissons ! Arrivée sur l’archipel des Sabaody !
title.es: Llegada a la entrada a la isla Gyojin, el archipiélago Shabondy
title.ru: Остановка ради Подводного острова – архипелаг Сабаоди!
title.ar: سنرسوا في طريقنا إلى جزيرة البرمائيّين! أرخبيل شابوندي!
title.x-jat: Gyojin-tou o Mezashite Jouriku: Sabaody Shotou
title.uk: Дорогою до острова Риболюдей. Архіпелаг Сабаоді

390.overview: With the Flying Fish Riders taken care of, the Straw Hats rest as Hatchan treats them to the promised Takoyaki. Duval shows up again, not for revenge, but to thank Sanji since his kicks altered Duval's face to become handsome and suave, or so he thinks. To make up for the trouble he's caused, he leaves his Den Den Mushi number with the Straw Hats in case they may need his assistance before departing with the newly christened Rosy Life Riders. The Sunny sets sail for the Sabaody Archipelago, the stepping stone to Fishman Island. Hatchan explains that one needs to have their ship coated with a bubble resin in order to travel underwater, and once they reach Sabaody, he promises to find them a ship coater that he trusts. He also warns them that the world nobility will be on the island, and no matter what happens, not to touch them, even if they witness a murder.
390.summary:
Enjoying takoyaki from a grateful Hatchan, he explains to the crew how to get to Fish-man Island.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 暴虐! シャボンディの支配者天竜人
title.en: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
title.fr: Quelle tyrannie ! Les dragons célestes, les maîtres de Sabaody
title.es: ¡Tiranía! Tenryūbito, los gobernantes de Shabondy
title.ru: Тирания! Тэнрюбито, правящие на Сабаоди
title.ar: طُغيان! حُكام شابوندي، التّنانين السّماويّون!
title.x-jat: Bougyaku! Sabaody no Shihaisha Tenryuubito
title.uk: Повна тиранія! Правителі Сабаоді: Тенрюбіто

391.overview: The crew splits up in order to explore the archipelago. Hatchan, Keimi, and Paggag lead Luffy, Chopper, and Brook to find the mechanic Hatchan spoke of. In town, they witness a disturbance caused by a man claiming to be an escaped slave yelling for help in getting an iron collar off. To the Straw Hats' horror, the collar explodes, severly injuring the man. Two people wearing gaudy clothing and bubble helmets, Saint Roswald and his daughter Saint Shalulia arrive and callously shoots his body twice before leaving him for the Marines to pick up. Paggag later explains that they were part of the Celestial Dragons, descendants of the founders of the World Government, and that they have the power to summon one of the three Admirals if they so please.
391.summary:
Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel. But it`s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 新たなライバル集結! 11人の超新星
title.en: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
title.fr: Les nouveaux rivaux se rencontrent ! Les 11 Supernovae
title.es: ¡Los nuevos rivales se agrupan! Los once supernovas
title.ru: Новые соперники! 11 Сверхновых!
title.ar: تجمّع الأنداد الجدد! السّوبرنوفا الأحد عشر!
title.x-jat: Arata na Rival Shuuketsu! 11-nin no Choushinsei
title.uk: Зібрання нових противників! 11 наднових

392.overview: After fighting their way through bounty hunters, Luffy's group arrives at a bar owned by a woman named Shakuyaku, an old friend of Hatchan's. The mechanic, Rayleigh, is not there, so Shakky suggests that they go searching for him at the Sabaody Amusement Park, but not before warning them to be careful, as right now there are nine other pirates on the Archipelago with bounties over 100,000,000 Beli. In addition to Luffy and Zoro, they are: Capone Gang Bege, Jewelry Bonney, Basil Hawkins, Eustass Kid, Scratchmen Apoo, Dies Drake, Urouge, Killer, and Trafalgar Law. Together, the group is known as the Eleven Supernovas.
392.summary:
Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line`s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy`s crew!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 標的はケイミー!! 迫る人攫い屋の魔手
title.en: The Target Is Camie! The Looming Clutches of a Professional Kidnapper
title.fr: Camie est visée ! Les terribles kidnappeurs s’approchent
title.es: ¡El objetivo es Camie! Se aproxima la mano del diablo de los secuestradores
title.ru: Цель – Кейми! Похитители совсем близко
title.ar: كِيْمي مستهدفة! براثن خاطف محترف تلوح في الأفق!
title.x-jat: Hyouteki wa Camie!! Semaru Hitosaraiya no Mashu
title.uk: Ціль — Кеймі!! Поява професійного крадія

393.overview: While walking through the groves, Zoro encounters another Celestial Dragon, Saint Charlos, harassing a group of townspeople. A fight almost breaks out, but Jewelry Bonney intervenes and tricks Charlos into thinking he killed him, after which she angrily berates him for picking a fight and almost getting an Admiral sent to the archipelago. Meanwhile, Luffy's group get caught up at the Sabaody Amusement Park, and Keimi ends up getting kidnapped by a group of slavers. When the Straw Hats still on board the Sunny learn of this, Sanji decides to call the Flying Fish Riders.
393.summary:
A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ケイミーを救え 諸島に残る暗黒の歴史
title.en: Rescue Caimie: The Archipelago`s Lingering Dark History
title.fr: Au secours de Camie ! Les vestiges des heures sombres de l’archipel
title.es: Al rescate de Camie, la oscura historia del archipiélago
title.ru: Спасти Кейми – тёмная история архипелага
title.ar: أنقذوا كيمي! التاريخ المظلم المستمر للأرخبيل
title.x-jat: Camie o Sukue: Shotou ni Nokoru Ankoku no Rekishi
title.uk: Врятувати Кеймі: темна сторона архіпелагу

394.overview: Duval and his crew arrive on the archipelago and start gathering the Straw Hats up to bring them to the Human Auction House, where the kidnappers have brought Keimi. Robin tells Nami why the Fishmen and Merpeople are not welcome on the island as in the past they had been discriminated against and classified as just fish. At the auction house itself await Saint Roswald and Saint Shalulia, as well as Trafalgar Law, Eustass Kid, and their crews. Backstage are Keimi and the other human merchandise, including the coating mechanic, Silvers Rayleigh, former first mate of Gold Roger himself.
394.summary:
Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: タイムリミット 人間[ヒューマン]オークション開幕
title.en: Time Limit: The Human Auction Begins
title.fr: Le temps nous est compté. La vente aux enchères des humains a commencé
title.es: Límite de tiempo, comienza la subasta de personas
title.ru: Время на исходе – начинается Людской аукцион
title.ar: حد زمني -- بدء المزاد البشري
title.x-jat: Time Limit: Human Auction Kaimaku

395.overview: The human auction finally begins, and it is only then that the Straw Hats discovered that their mermaid friend is being sold off at Grove 1. After rendezvousing there (save for Zoro, Luffy, Brook, and Robin), their initial plan to extract Keimi is thwarted upon learning that the World Government and the Celestial Dragons are involved in the slave trade, so Nami decides that they'll buy Keimi back in the auction itself. Meanwhile, the rest of the archipelago receives news that the World Government is going to execute the captured Portgas D. Ace, a move that could provoke a war with Whitebeard.
395.summary:
With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 鉄拳炸裂! オークションをぶっつぶせ
title.en: The Fist Explodes! Destroy the Auction
title.fr: Un coup de poing explosif ! Une vente aux enchères à massacrer
title.es: ¡El puño explosivo! Destruye la subasta
title.ru: Рвущийся в бой кулак! Уничтожить аукцион!
title.ar: تتفجّر القبضة! حطّموا المزاد
title.x-jat: Tekken Sakuretsu! Auction o Buttsubuse
title.uk: Вибух кулаків! Знищити аукціон!

396.overview: The auction continues, but Saint Charloss arrives and ruins the Straw Hats' plan to buy Keimi back by placing an exorbiant bid on her. The proceedings are then interupted when Luffy and his Flying Fish crash into the auction house, but he is restrained from rushing the stage by Hatchan, who accidentally reveals his Fishman nature in the process. While the nobility recoils in disgust, Charloss shoots him, gloating about obtaining a Fishman slave. Luffy snaps and punches the man in the face.
396.summary:
Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 大パニック! オークション会場の死闘
title.en: Major Panic! Desperate Struggle at the Auction House
title.fr: C’est la panique ! Grosse bagarre dans la salle des ventes
title.es: ¡Gran pánico! Pelea a muerte en el salón de la subasta
title.ru: Всеобщая паника! Хаос в аукционном доме
title.ar: ذعر كبير! كفاح يائس في دار المزاد
title.x-jat: Dai Panic! Auction Kaijou no Shitou
title.uk: Велика паніка! Відчайдушна битва в аукціонному домі

397.overview: In the aftermath of Luffy's punch, a fight breaks out in the auction hall between the staff, the Celestial Dragons' bodyguards, and the Straw Hats, aided by the arrivals of Usopp, Brook, and Robin. A freed Rayleigh then emerges from backstage, and ends the conflict by using a mysterious power to render the Straw Hats' enemies unconscious.
397.summary:
Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a celestial dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 大将黄猿動く! 騒然シャボンディ諸島
title.en: Admiral Kizaru Takes Action! Sabaody Archipelago Thrown into Chaos
title.fr: L`amiral Kizaru se déplace ! L`archipel des Sabaody est dans le chaos
title.es: ¡El Almirante Kizaru avanza! El alborotado archipiélago Shaobody
title.ru: Выезд адмирала Кизару! Архипелаг в Панике
title.ar: يأخذ الأميرال كيزارو زمام المبادرة! يقع أرخبيل شابوندي في الفوضى
title.x-jat: Taishou Kizaru Ugoku! Souzen Sabaody Shotou
title.uk: Адмірал Кізару вступає у бій! Архіпелаг Сабаоді впадає у хаос

398.overview: News of the attack on the World Nobles reaches the pirates in the town, as well as the Marine Headquarters, where Kizaru decides to go to the island in order to deal with the situation. Donquixote Doflamingo, who owns the auction house, tells Disco that the Seven Warlords will be called to war against the Whitebeard Pirates. Rayleigh introduces himself to the Straw Hats, frees Camie from her collar, and notes that he is the coating engineer that they have been looking for. Luffy, Kid and Law go out to fight the Marines, who are no match for their Devil Fruit abilities.
398.summary:
They saved Cami from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass Captain Kid and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 包囲網を突破せよ! 海軍VS三人の船長
title.en: Break Through the Siege! The Navy vs. the Three Captains
title.fr: Briser les lignes ennemies ! La Marine contre les trois capitaines
title.es: ¡Atraviesa el sitio! Los marinos contra tres capitanes
title.ru: Прорывая окружение! Флот против трёх капитанов!
title.ar: اخترقوا الحصار! البحريّة ضدّ القباطنة الثّلاثة!
title.x-jat: Houimou o Toppa Seyo! Kaigun Tai Sannin no Senchou
title.uk: Прорвати блокаду! Варта проти трьох капітанів

399.overview: Luffy, Law and Kid's crews join the fight, defeat the rest of the marines outside the auction house, promising to meet and fight in the New World. Luffy's crew escapes with the help of the Rosy Life Riders. A mysterious figure that appears to be Kuma intercepts Kid and Law, then begins attacking them with lasers.
399.summary:
The Straw Hats join forces with Kid’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ロジャーとレイリー 海賊王とその右腕
title.en: Roger and Rayleigh: The King of the Pirates and His Right Hand Man
title.fr: Roger et Rayleigh : le Roi des pirates et son bras droit
title.it: Il Re dei pirati e il suo braccio destro
title.es: Roger y Rayleigh - El Rey de los piratas y su mano derecha
title.ru: Роджер и Рэйли! Король пиратов и его Правая рука
title.ar: روجر وريلي! ملك القراصنة وذراعه اليمنى!
title.x-jat: Roger to Rayleigh: Kaizoku Ou to Sono Migiude
title.uk: Роджер і Рейлі: Король піратів та його права рука

400.overview: Upon arriving back at Shakky's Bar, Rayleigh reveals to the Straw Hats that he was first mate to the legendary Gold Roger and the truth to his crew's dismissal. Thus they leave soon after with a bit of Rayleigh's Vivrecard for each of them, and he tells them to come back in three days when their ship will be ready. Meanwhile, Admiral Kizaru arrives at the Archipelago.
400.summary:
Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 回避不可能!? 大将黄猿の光速の蹴り!!
title.en: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru`s Light Speed Kick!!
title.fr: Un coup de pied impossible à éviter ? La vitesse-lumière de l’amiral Kizaru !
title.it: Un calcio alla velocità della luce
title.es: ¿Imposible de evitar? La patada a la velocidad de la luz del Almirante Kizaru
title.ru: Невозможно избежать! Световой пинок Адмирала Кизару!
title.ar: لا مهرب؟! ركلة الأميرال كيزارو ذات سرعة الضّوء!
title.x-jat: Kaihi Fukanou!? Taishou Kizaru no Kousoku no Keri
title.uk: Безвихідь!? Удар світла адмірала Кізару!!

401.overview: Admiral Kizaru appears in the Archipelago and demonstrates his mysterious light abilities before taking on the Supernova Basil Hawkins, while Urouge and Drake fight a Pacifista. Kidd and Law continue their bout with another Pacifista while the Straw Hat Pirates come face to face with a third one. A shady figure with a giant broadaxe is seen at the end, waiting for a call.
401.summary:
Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 圧倒的! 海軍の戦闘兵器パシフィスタ
title.en: Overwhelming! The Navy`s Fighting Weapons, the Pacifistas
title.fr: Une puissance écrasante ! Les Pacifista, les machines de guerre de la Marine
title.es: ¡Aterrador! El arma de combate de la Marina, Pacifista
title.ru: Подавление! Боевое оружие Дозора – Пацифиста
title.ar: كاسح! أسلحة البحريّة القتاليّة، الباسيفيستا!
title.x-jat: Attouteki! Kaigun no Sentou Heiki Pacifista
title.uk: Приголомшливо! Бойова зброя варти — Пацифіста

402.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates fight against one of the Pacifistas, and while it does not have Kuma's Devil Fruit powers, it is still able to withstand their strongest attacks while firing devastating lasers at the crew. Elsewhere on the archipelago, Kizaru easily defeats Hawkins, Urouge, Drake and Apoo before Sentomaru contacts him. The situation for the Straw Hats grows even more desperate as Zoro suffers pain from his wounds.
402.summary:
A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a warlord lookalike.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: さらなる強敵現る! 鉞かついだ戦桃丸
title.en: An Even Stronger Enemy Appears! The Battle Axe-Carrying Sentomaru
title.fr: Un ennemi puissant de plus apparaît ! Sentômaru et sa hache à équarrir
title.es: ¡Aparece otro enemigo fuerte! Sentōmaru, el empuñador del gran hacha
title.ru: Ещё один сильный противник! Сэнтомару и его топор!
title.ar: ظهور عدوّ أشدّ قوّة! حامل فأس المعركة سينتومارو
title.x-jat: Saranaru Kyouteki Arawaru! Masakari Katsuida Sentoumaru
title.uk: Ще сильніший ворог! Бойова сокира Сентомару

403.overview: The Straw Hats combine their strongest attacks to defeat the Pacifista, but are exhausted after the battle. Sentomaru arrives with another Pacifista, and Luffy attempts to escape, dividing the Straw Hats into three groups. Unfortunately, Sentomaru intercepts his group, the Pacifista cuts off Sanji's group, and Kizaru attacks Zoro's group, knocking Zoro down and preparing to finish him off.
403.summary:
Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far more deadly foe comes looking for a fight.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 大将黄猿の猛攻 麦わら一味絶体絶命!
title.en: Admiral Kizaru`s Fierce Assault: The Straw Hats Face Certain Death!
title.fr: L`attaque féroce de l`amiral Kizaru. Les pirates au chapeau de paille dos au mur
title.es: El feroz ataque del Almirante Kizaru - ¡La desesperación de los sombrero de paja!
title.ru: Атака адмирала Кизару! Команда Мугивары в критической ситуации!
title.ar: هجوم الأميرال كيزارو الضّاري! يواجه طاقم قبّعة القشّ الموت المؤكّد
title.x-jat: Taishou Kizuru no Moukou Mugiwara Ichimi Zettaizetsumei!
title.uk: Запеклий рейд адмірала Кізару! Мугіварам загрожує неминуча загибель!

404.overview: Usopp and Brook's attempts to attack Kizaru fail, but Rayleigh arrives, managing to block Kizaru's attack and hold him off. Luffy orders his crew to retreat, declaring the enemies impossible for them to defeat at this time, but Sentomaru and the other Pacifista bar their escape and even Chopper's Monster Point form is unable to turn the situation to their advantage. The real Kuma arrives and uses his Devil Fruit powers to make Zoro disappear.
404.summary:
Zoro’s barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 消された仲間たち 麦わら一味最後の日
title.en: Eliminated Friends: The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
title.fr: Des compagnons qui ont disparu. Le jour où l’équipage au chapeau de paille s’est éteint
title.es: La Tripulación desaparece, el último día de la tripulación de los sombrero de paja
title.ru: Исчезнувшие накама. Последний день команды Соломенной шляпы
title.ar: أصدقاءٌ منبوذون! اليوم الأخير لطاقم قبّعة القشّ
title.x-jat: Kesareta Nakama-tachi: Mugiwara Ichimi Saigo no Hi
title.uk: Ліквідовані накама — останній день команди мугівар!

405.overview: Sentomaru lets out that Kuma's powers send people flying through the air for days, and that Luffy should give up on ever seeing Zoro again. Kuma's motivations become questionable when he vanishes the Pacifista, gives Rayleigh some secret information, and refuses to explain himself to Kizaru. He then goes after each of the Straw Hats, vanishing them one-by-one before Luffy's helpless eyes. Brook falls trying to protect Usopp and Sanji, Usopp falls as he tries to get away, Sanji falls when he attacks in retaliation, Franky falls when he tries to get past Kuma, Nami falls as she pleads to Luffy for help, Chopper falls as he continues his mindless rampage, and Robin falls as she tries to flee. Luffy breaks down sobbing at the realization that he's alone and he failed his crew, as Kuma tells him that they will never meet again before vanishing him too. The Straw Hat Pirates have been completely annihilated.
405.summary:
One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 時代劇特別編 ルフィ親分ふたたび見参
title.en: Feudal Era Side Story: Boss Luffy Appears Again
title.fr: De retour à l’époque féodale ! Luffy le chef est toujours là !
title.es: Capítulo especial histórico, el jefe Luffy aparece de nuevo
title.ru: Босс Луффи снова появляется!
title.ar: قصّة العصر الإقطاعيّ الجانبيّة! يظهر الزّعيم لوفي ثانيةً
title.x-jat: Jidaigeki Tokubetsu Hen: Luffy Oyabun Futatabi Kenzan
title.uk: Побічна історія, епоха феодалізму: Бос Луффі зʼявляється знову!

406.overview: In Grand Jipang a race is about to be held where a team carries a portable shrine to the finish line. The prize isthe chance to see a legendary treasure that is said to grant wishes. The deziens of the Kazeguruma restaurant sign up, entrusting the craftsman Franky with the construction of their shrine. Usopp also fishes a talking, amnesiac skeleton named Brook from a river. However, the ghostly Thriller Company is working to sabotage the other race teams, and Brook leaves his new friends when he recovers his memories as a former member of the Company. Also this filler introduces a filler only character Omao, who works with Onami at her restaurant.
406.summary:
Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a warlord of the sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 時代劇特別編 破れ! スリラー商会の罠
title.en: Feudal Era Side Story: Defeat Thriller Company`s Trap
title.fr: De retour à l’époque féodale ! Un piège à déjouer ! Le plan de la Thriller Company
title.it: Il piano della Thriller Company viene sventato
title.es: Capítulo especial histórico ¡Destruye! la trampa del grupo Thriller
title.ru: Уничтожить! Ловушка Триллер-компании!
title.ar: قصّة العصر الإقطاعيّ الجانبيّة — اهزموا فخّ شركة الإثارة
title.x-jat: Jidaigeki Tokubetsu Hen: Yabure! Thriller Shoukai no Wana
title.uk: Побічна історія, епоха феодалізму: Пастка Трилер-Компані!

407.overview: Brook goes off to try to defeat the Thriller Company himself, but ends up their captive, but Luffy and Zoro rescue him. The next day is the day of the race, with the Kazagaruma restaurant competing against the Thriller Company. After an intense and destructive race, Kazagaruma emerges victorious, and get to see the legendary treasure: a golden pair of women's underwear.
407.summary:
Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 上陸! 男子禁制の島アマゾン・リリー
title.en: Landing! The All-Female Island, Amazon Lily
title.fr: Atterrissage ! Une île interdite aux hommes, Amazon Lily
title.es: ¡Aterrizaje! Amazon Lily, la isla prohibida para los hombres
title.ru: Приземление! Остров без мужчин, Амазония Лили
title.ar: هبوط! الجزيرة المحرّمة على الرّجال، أمازون ليلي!
title.x-jat: Jouriku! Danshi Kinsei no Shima Amazon Lily
title.uk: Приземлення! Жіночий острів Амазон Лілі

408.overview: After flying through the air for several days, Luffy finds himself in the middle of a jungle. He tries to use Rayleigh's Vivrecard to find his way back to Sabaody, but only tires himself out. He then kills a boar and eats it, and also eats a mushroom that turns out ot be parasitic and poisons him. His body is then discovered by a young woman named Marguerite and her friends, and mistaking him for a child from their village, they bring him back to treat him, and learn, much to their surprise, that he is a man. Luffy is in the middle of the Calm Belt, on the island of Amazon Lily, home to the all-female Kuja Amazon tribe.
408.summary:
Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man’s amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 急げ! 仲間たちのもとへ 女ヶ島の冒険
title.en: Hurry Back to Your Friends! The Maiden Island Adventure
title.fr: Dépêche-toi de retrouver tes compagnons ! Aventure sur l`île des femmes
title.es: ¡Rápido! De vuelta a los compañeros, aventura en la isla de las mujeres
title.ru: Скорее! Вернуться к команде – приключение на Острове женщин
title.ar: أسرع إلى أصدقائك! مغامرة جزيرة النّساء
title.x-jat: Isoge! Nakama-tachi no Moto e: Nyougashima no Bouken
title.uk: Поспішай до своїх накама! Пригоди на острові жінок

409.overview: Luffy wakes up inside a cage, surrounded by the curious Amazons. Marguerite gives him a new pair of cloths to wear, but then the other Amazons decide to finish him off, as they detest men. They attack Luffy with cannon-strength archery, but he grabs Marguerite and manages to escape into the jungle, where he gets his Vivre Card back from her. Although initially distrustful, Marguerite's curiosity gets the better of her and learns that he's a pirate. She reveals that Amazon Lily's empress, Boa Hancock, is in command of an all-female pirate crew, which, unbeknownst to the two, is on its way back to the island.
409.summary:
An army of scantily-clad Amazonian warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: みんなメロメロ! 海賊女帝ハンコック
title.en: Everyone Falls in Love! Pirate Empress Hancock
title.fr: Tout le monde en est amoureux ! Hancock, l`impératrice pirate
title.es: ¡Todos ebrios de amor! La emperatriz pirata Hancock
title.ru: Каждый влюблён! Императрица-пират Хэнкок
title.ar: يقع الجميع في الحبّ! الإمبراطورة القرصانة هانكوك!
title.x-jat: Minna Meromero! Kaizoku Jotei Hancock
title.uk: Усі закохуються! Піратська імператриця Генкок

410.overview: Luffy attempts to make a raft to leave the island, but utterly fails and has to be saved from drowning by Marguerite. She determines that she's getting too attached to him, and resorts to attacking him with her super-powered archery, which she reveals is the result of Ambition, the same power that Rayleigh used to knock out everyone at Sabaody. Luffy is then driven off by the arrival of the other Amazons. Offshore, the ship of Boa Hancock and her two younger sisters is met by a Marine battleship helmed by Vice-Admiral Momonga, who is there to take Hancock, the final Shichibukai to Mariejois in preperation for the battle with Whitebeard. Hancock uses the Swoon Swoon Fruit (Mero Mero no Mi) to petrify the lovestruck Marines, and tells Momonga that she refuses the order.
410.summary:
The Amazonians chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 背中に隠された秘密 遭遇ルフィと蛇姫
title.en: The Secret Hidden on the Backs: Luffy and the Snake Princess Meet
title.fr: Un secret caché dans leur dos. Luffy et la princesse serpent se rencontrent
title.es: El secreto oculto en sus espaldas, Luffy se encuentra con la princesa serpiente
title.ru: Секрет, скрытый на их спинах – встреча Луффи и Принцессы змей
title.ar: السّرّ المخفيّ على ظهرها، لقاء لوفي وأميرة الثّعابين!
title.x-jat: Senaka ni Kakusareta Himitsu: Souguu Luffy to Hebihime
title.uk: Таємниця прихована на її спині: Луффі та Зміїна принцеса зустрілися

411.overview: While stumbling around Amazon Lily, Luffy decides to find the head of the kuja pirates and looks for the highest building,he crashes into the bath where the snake princess was bathing and sees her back.
411.summary:
Luffy’s search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 非情の裁き! 石にされたマーガレット!!
title.en: Heartless Judgment! Margaret Is Turned to Stone!!
title.fr: Un jugement impitoyable ! Margaret est transformée en pierre !
title.es: ¡Juicio sin piedad! ¡Margaret es convertida en piedra!
title.ru: Бессердечное наказание! Маргарет обратилась в камень!
title.ar: حكم قاسٍ! تتحوّل مارغريت إلى حجر!
title.x-jat: Hijou no Sabaki! Ishi ni Sareta Margaret!!
title.uk: Безсердечний вирок! Маргарет перетворили на камінь!!

412.overview: Luffy plans to find the "Important Person" to help him ride a ship and give him a free guide at the sea. But suddenly, Luffy falls at Hancock's bath which surprises Luffy to find whats behind Hancock's back and telling her that he saw it before and misunderstanding Hancock's Love abilities as Foxy's Noro Noro Beam. When Luffy is soon captured, he was sent to an arena to be executed. Telling the truth, Margueritte and her friends was turned into stone by Hancock.
412.summary:
Boa Hancock makes Luffy fighting mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging captain Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: ルフィ大苦戦! ヘビ姉妹の覇気の力!!
title.en: A Difficult Fight for Luffy! The Snake Sisters` Haki Power!!
title.fr: Duel compliqué pour Luffy ! Le pouvoir du fluide des sœurs Gorgones !
title.es: ¡La dura prueba de Luffy! ¡El poder del haki de las hermanas serpiente!

416.overview: After telling Luffy all about her past, Hancock accepts to give him a ride to Sabaody Archipelago on her Yuda-towed ship. She also invites Luffy for their banquet tonight and goes inside to rest. At the banquet, Luffy eats everything around him, and the girls seem suspicious. The Kuja Pirates misunderstand their Hebihime's action and prepare to attack Luffy. But before they can, Luffy feels bored, he starts to sing Bink's sake and dance with pan and spoon. It makes everyone laugh, and the party starts. But the girls, who have never seen man before, stick to Luffy, picking him up. He escape with Marguerite to Elder Nyon's house. There, Luffy learns that Hancock is a Shichibukai, and that his brother Ace is about taken to his execution. He says sorry to his comrades, and asks Elder Nyon how he can rescue Ace. Elder Nyon tells him that there's only one way of making it to his brother in time, and that is asking Hancock to accept the call of the Marines. But, Hancock, has been stricken by an unknown disease.

Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.

After they perform the Super Dance, Franky freezes and is saved by transforming him into a Daijirin Tea Power Cyborg.

Heracles soon informs Usopp that hes on an island inhabited by man eating plants.

Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!

Ace says it is impossible because both he and Luffy are descendants of criminals, and that as he does not remember or care for his father, he took on his mother's name and considers Whitebeard his only father. The Buggy Pirates sail towards Impel Down, hoping to free the captured Buggy. Alvida refuses to risk herself for Buggy, suggesting that Impel Down is impossible to break into.

Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!

Luffy and Buggy meanwhile find Level 2 to be filled with wild animals, but Luffy manages to handle them without too much trouble. Buggy manages to unlock several of the prisoner cells, and the two fugitives are joined by none other than Baroque Works officer agent Mr. 3.

Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!

426.overview: In a flashback, it is revealed that 20 years ago, a pirate named "Gold Lion" Shiki cut off his legs and escaped from Impel Down. A few days before the start of the movie, Gold Lion Shiki contacts the Amigo Pirates, a crew of pirates led by a man named Largo, offering to make them the 51st crew under his command if they fulfill a certain request. Meanwhile Luffy, Usopp, Chopper and Brook try to catch a large fish, but it ends up getting eaten by a large beetle named "Boss". Luffy starts fighting the beetle with the intention of making it part of his crew, but it flies toward an island with him, Zoro, Sanji and Usopp in tow. Yoko, a girl wearing a Marine coat appears, attacking Luffy over how he treated Boss, and some people emerge from the island and reveal that they have been living while running from all threats, because the Marines do not protect them. Yoko's father was a Marine who died defending them five years ago, and she first met Boss three years after his death. They show the four Straw Hats their village, which strongly resembles East Blue to the point of having replicas of several prominent buildings. The villagers ask Luffy to bring Nami to the village, and as Nami heads to the village on the modified Waver, Largo's pirates head to the island to fulfill Shiki's request to get the beetle that left his hideout.
426.summary:
Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
Source: crunchyroll

427.overview: The Straw Hats meet with people in places that remind them of where they came from, and Yoko becomes irritated at how easily they are bonding. The Amigo Pirates decide to head ashore, but because Largo is taking a nap, Colt leads them. Nami meets with the "Orenami" fan club, who leads her through a maze and shows her a naked statue of her, which offends her. She sees Yoko, and finds that Yoko reminds her of herself when she first met Luffy. While the Straw Hats are at a party, the Amigo pirates attack, destroying much of the village, and demand the beetle. Luffy easily defeats Colt and his men with Zoro and Sanji's help, but Largo traps him in a needled net.
427.summary:
The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
Source: crunchyroll

428.overview: The rest of the Straw Hats hear the fighting on the island and decide to head over. Zoro and Sanji attempt to attack Largo, who uses his Net Net Fruit powers to create nets out of materials that he eats and captures the two of them. Largo and Colt threaten to exterminate the town if they do not get the beetle, and Boss comes out to fight them, but is quickly defeated. Boss decides to sacrifice himself to save the village, despite Yoko's objections, but Luffy tears open the net and punches Boss, saying that he wants to fight with him again. Boss sheds his skin and is able to fly long enough to burn Luffy, Zoro and Sanji's nets. The Straw Hats and the villagers prepare to fight the Amigo Pirates.
428.summary:
Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!
Source: crunchyroll

429.overview: After escaping from the net, Luffy knocks Largo far away and goes off to fight him. Nami pretends to evacuate the villagers, but takes them through other tunnels to surprise the Amigo pirates while they are fighting Zoro and Sanji. Luffy fights Largo, but becomes trapped when he turns his entire body into a net. Luffy uses Gear Third to inflate and burst the net before defeating Largo with Gigant Pistol, destroying his ship in the process. Boss saves Luffy from falling into the sea and then starts fighting him in a rematch that lasts for hours. Yoko and Nami discuss their respective pasts, before Nami brings the Straw Hats together and sets sail from the island. It is revealed that Boss was a specially created insect that had escaped from Shiki, and that he plans on using an army of similar creatures to wage war on the world.
429.summary:
Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.

They are chased into the lair of an enormous beast, the Sphinx, which frightens off the other animals. The Sphnix is a large powerful creature which bizzarely can only speak by saying types of noodles. Mr. 3 attempts to distract the creature by creating wax copies of himself, but only succeeds in provoking the creature into destroying the floor beneath them.
430.summary:
Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.
